Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CROSS, a training-free library of typed geometric operators and spatial skills that function over available evidence to support reliable video spatial reasoning. The resulting library supplies verified context to non-coding VLMs or callable skills to a SpatialClaw agent. We evaluate \methodname{} on five benchmarks. \methodname{} raises the average score from 55.9\% to 60.2\% on ReVSI and improves the SpatialClaw result from 62.8\% to 66.3\% on DSI-Bench. These gains demonstrate that explicit handling of spatial conventions can repair systematic reasoning failures without additional training.

</details>


### [151] [Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02000)
*Hossein Maghsoumi,George Atia,Yaser P. Fallah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出WA-ADDA（天气感知对抗判别域适应）方法，解决街景图像在域偏移下的多类天气识别问题，并构建了统一的多数据集基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雨、雪、雾、沙尘等恶劣天气对自动驾驶中基于摄像头的感知构成持续挑战。现有天气识别的训练数据多来自非街景来源，与真实驾驶场景差异显著，导致明显的域偏移问题。

Method: 提出WA-ADDA方法，将域判别器以预测天气为条件，促使特征同时具备域不变性和天气敏感性；同时整合多样化的非街景天气数据集作为源域、真实街景图像作为目标域，构建多数据集基准，并定义以宏平均准确率为主指标的标准化评估协议。

Result: 在ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet多种骨干网络上，WA-ADDA均稳定提升街景图像上的识别性能，在恶劣条件下各类别召回率表现良好，同时保持晴天条件下的准确率。

Conclusion: 结果验证了域适应天气识别的可行性，并体现了该基准对推动鲁棒车载感知研究的价值。

Abstract: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.

</details>


### [152] [Task-Adaptive Grounded 3D-Programmers Using 2D VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02021)
*Arman Raayatsanati,Sombit Dey,Anna-Maria Halacheva,Jan-Nico Zaech,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出通过Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF)和Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF)让2D视觉语言模型可靠地执行3D任务，并构建了无需重训练的3D-Prog框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽具备强大的泛化与推理能力，但其3D理解受限于数据规模、训练多样性和推理能力。作者不选择简单地将2D模型扩展到3D，而是希望让强大的2D VLM可靠地在3D场景中工作。

Method: 引入两个新概念：Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF)，作为统一视觉表示，将输入和输出锚定到共享欧氏坐标系，解决轴歧义、度量尺度不一致和漂浮参考等问题；Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF)，通过任务自适应动态反馈闭合推理环路，使2D VLM能在原生视觉上下文中执行开放词汇任务。基于此构建3D-Prog框架，联合CCF与TAF及强大VLM，无需重训练。

Result: 3D-Prog可在对象级和场景级任务上执行开放词汇3D理解、操作与生成；实验表明CCF与TAF联合使用可将2D VLM转化为几何感知的3D程序器，在多样3D任务中获得一致、可解释且高质量的结果。

Conclusion: 通过CCF与TAF的结构化3D输入锚定和反馈闭环，可在不重训练的情况下将2D VLM有效提升为几何感知的3D任务执行者。

Abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable generalization and reasoning abilities, yet 3D understanding in these models is limited by data scale, training diversity, and reasoning capacity. Instead of naively extending these models into 3D, we take a different approach: we enable powerful 2D VLMs to operate reliably in 3D by introducing 3D grounding and iterative feedback loops with two novel concepts: Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) and Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF). CCF serves as a unified visual representation that anchors both inputs and outputs to a shared Euclidean coordinate system, solving common challenges in 3D grounding such as axis ambiguity, inconsistent metric scale, and floating references. Complementary to this structured framing of the 3D inputs, TAF closes the reasoning loop with task-adaptive dynamic feedback that enables 2D VLMs to perform varied open-vocabulary tasks within their native visual context.
  Building on this foundation, we introduce 3D-Prog, a 3D understanding, reasoning, and generation framework that jointly employs the capabilities of CCF and TAF together with powerful VLMs. Without requiring any retraining, 3D-Prog performs open-vocabulary 3D understanding, manipulation, and generation across both object-level and scene-level tasks. Our experiments show that the joint use of CCF and TAF transforms 2D VLMs into geometry-aware 3D programmers, achieving consistent, interpretable, and high-quality results across diverse 3D tasks.

</details>


### [153] [DiDE:Direct Injection with Color-Texture DEcoupling for 3D Stylization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02044)
*Tao Wu,Alexandra Gomez-Villa,Senmao Li,Yaxing Wang,Joost van de Weijer,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个免训练的解耦3D风格化框架DiDE，实现颜色与纹理的独立控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于rectified flow的图像到3D生成模型的风格化方法采用"全有或全无"范式，颜色和纹理被联合迁移，无法独立控制，作者将此局限形式化为Disentangled 3D Stylization (Disen3D)。

Method: DiDE基于一个观察：图像到3D模型的结构化潜空间相对纹理是过完备的，纹理信息仅占据少量风格显著通道，留有自由子空间可独立编码颜色。方法采用通道划分机制，将内容图、纹理参考、颜色参考分别通过专用分支处理，并在每个自注意力层无干扰地组合两种风格信号，同时保持内容几何。

Result: 在新建的多参考基准Disen3D-Bench上，DiDE在颜色保真度、纹理迁移和内容保持方面持续优于2D和3D风格化基线。

Conclusion: DiDE是首个免训练的Disen3D框架，通过潜空间通道划分实现了颜色与纹理的解耦控制，效果优于现有基线。

Abstract: Recent advances in rectified flow-based image-to-3D generative models have enabled high-fidelity 3D asset generation. Building on this, a growing line of work has exploited these strong 3D priors for training-free stylization, transferring visual attributes from a reference image onto a generated 3D asset. However, existing methods enforce an all-or-nothing paradigm: color and texture are transferred jointly, with no mechanism to control them independently -- a limitation we formalize as Disentangled 3D Stylization(Disen3D). To address this, we propose DiDE, the first training-free framework for Disen3D. Key to our approach is the observation that the structured latent space of image-to-3D models is overcomplete with respect to texture: texture information occupies only a small subset of the style-significant channels, leaving a free subspace available for independent color encoding. DiDE exploits this via a channel partition mechanism that processes a content image, a texture reference, and a color reference through dedicated branches and composes both style signals interference-free at every self-attention layer, preserving content geometry throughout. Experiments on Disen3D-Bench, our newly collected multi-reference benchmark, show that DiDE consistently outperforms 2D and 3D stylization baselines in color fidelity, texture transfer, and content preservation.

</details>


### [154] [Form and Void: Entangled Composition through an Autonomous AI Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02045)
*Shiwen Wang,Jian Yang,Xu Wang,Xincan Wang,Weiming Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FaV-A（Form and Void Agent），一个分阶段生成正负空间构图的多模态智能体，效果优于直接零样本 MLLM 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正负空间是视觉构图的基本原则，能支撑视觉连贯的形态与多层次语义关系。生成此类构图具有挑战性，因为需要对共享同一边界的两个语义概念进行协同控制。尽管现有文生图模型与多模态大模型在图像生成与视觉理解上表现优异，正负空间生成仍很困难，尤其在直接单次提示（single-pass prompting）条件下。

Method: 提出 FaV-A（Form and Void Agent），一种用于分阶段正负空间生成的多模态智能体。其渐进式工作流为：先生成基础物体；再分析其形状与空间结构以识别候选的负空间语义；最后生成构图指令，用于最终图像生成阶段。

Result: 实验与消融分析表明，FaV-A 在生成视觉连贯且语义对齐的正负空间构图方面，比直接零样本 MLLM 基线更有效。

Conclusion: FaV-A 为分阶段正负空间生成提供了更有效的框架，验证了渐进式多模态智能体流程相较直接零样本提示范式的优势。

Abstract: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the \textbf{F}orm \textbf{a}nd \textbf{V}oid \textbf{A}gent (\textbf{FaV-A}), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.

</details>


### [155] [Learning from Failure: Leveraging Unreliable Predictions in Semi-Supervised Real-World Adverse Weather Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02051)
*Cap Dang Xuan Kiet,Tat-Jen Cham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出学生-教师半监督框架，利用可靠/不可靠数据库与相位谱语义约束，实现真实场景恶劣天气图像恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一恢复模型依赖合成监督、语义约束不足，导致对真实场景泛化能力有限。

Method: 构建学生-教师半监督框架：不可靠数据库保存教师失败预测作为负样本用于对比学习，可靠数据库保存高质量预测作为正样本；提出基于相位谱的语义约束替代昂贵的文本监督；设计自适应相位一致性损失，按退化严重程度动态平衡输入与教师伪真值间的监督。

Result: 在真实世界基准上，恢复质量与感知保真度持续优于现有最先进方法，对真实恶劣天气条件具有更强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 联合利用可靠伪真值与不可靠教师输出可增强理想恢复特性并规避常见失败，相位谱语义先验为高效自然的语义约束方案。

Abstract: Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover images degraded by rain, haze, snow, and other weather-induced artifacts, thereby improving the robustness of outdoor vision systems. Existing unified restoration models exhibit limited generalization to real-world scenes due to their reliance on synthetic supervision and insufficient semantic constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel student--teacher semi-supervised framework that addresses both challenges. Specifically, we introduce an unreliable database that preserves failed teacher predictions as informative negative samples for contrastive learning, while a reliable database stores high-quality teacher predictions as positive samples. By jointly exploiting reliable pseudo-ground truths and unreliable teacher outputs, the proposed framework learns to enhance desirable restoration characteristics while avoiding common failures. We further propose a phase spectrum-based semantic constraint that replaces computationally expensive text-based supervision with an efficient and naturally aligned semantic prior. An adaptive phase consistency loss is also designed to dynamically balance supervision between the degraded input and teacher pseudo-ground truths according to degradation severity. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in restoration quality and perceptual fidelity while exhibiting stronger generalization to real-world adverse weather conditions.

</details>


### [156] [GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02091)
*Yakun Zhu,Yi Bin,Yujuan Ding,Zheng Wang,Pengpeng Zeng,Duo Peng,Jingkuan Song,Heng Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoLatent，通过Common-Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO)与路由优化，分解并结构化几何隐表示，同时促进隐表示中介的答案学习，在SPAR-Bench和SPBench上分别达到73.0%和72.1%，超越已有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从2D图像进行3D空间推理仍然困难：基于文本的方法用离散token描述中间几何，难以保真连续空间关系；连续隐表示虽更丰富，但单一隐类型无法显式分离不同空间任务所需的线索；分解式空间隐表示虽可分离位置、方向与全局几何，但几何表示易坍缩到单一主导方向，且无约束注意力会导致隐表示在答案学习中被利用不足。

Method: 提出GeoLatent，结合CR-GEO与路由优化。CR-GEO将教师几何分为共享与残差部分以结构化几何状态；路由优化联合训练几何与语言，暂时将视觉答案学习导向隐表示，并在几何监督下恢复完整注意力。

Result: 在受控比较中，CR-GEO将几何有效秩从1.00提升到3.87；在瓶颈处阻断隐读取会使128个固定问题上的方向准确率从89.1%降至25.8%。恢复后，分化的几何表示与隐中介视觉路径仍可与直接图像访问并存。GeoLatent在SPAR-Bench上达73.0%，SPBench上达72.1%，两项均优于此前报告的方法。

Conclusion: GeoLatent通过分解并结构化几何隐表示及路由优化，有效缓解几何坍缩与隐表示利用不足问题，实现了更强的3D空间推理性能。

Abstract: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervision. Yet the geometry representation can still collapse toward one dominant direction, and unrestricted attention can leave the latents underused during answer learning. We introduce GeoLatent, combining Common--Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure the geometry states while promoting latent-mediated answer learning. CR-GEO separates shared from residual teacher geometry; routed optimization jointly trains geometry and language, temporarily directs visual answer learning through the latents, and restores full attention with geometry supervision. In controlled comparisons, CR-GEO raises geometry effective rank from 1.00 to 3.87, while blocking latent readout at the bottleneck lowers direction accuracy from 89.1% to 25.8% on 128 fixed questions. After recovery, the differentiated geometry representation and latent-mediated visual route remain available alongside direct image access. GeoLatent achieves 73.0% on SPAR-Bench and 72.1% on SPBench, outperforming previously reported methods on both.

</details>


### [157] [Surface-volume self-supervised representation learning of brain MRI for genetic discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02114)
*Tian Xia,Nuo Chen,Zihao Zhu,Huiwen Han,Ziqian Xie,Zhiwen Fan,Degui Zhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MEVA将体素级图像强度与皮层网格几何融合到共享自监督特征中，作为GWAS表型可检出更多全基因组显著位点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑影像GWAS的影像表型要么来自体积扫描，要么来自皮层表面网格，各自只捕获脑解剖可遗传变异的一部分，缺乏统一表示。

Method: 提出MEVA自监督框架，编码体素级图像强度以及皮层网格几何（每个表面顶点的曲率与皮层厚度）到同一组影像特征中；在UK Biobank中用于年龄/性别预测并以这些特征作为表型进行GWAS。

Result: 融合网格与体积输入在年龄和性别预测上相比单一输入有适度性能提升；作为GWAS表型时，检出的全基因组显著位点多于仅用体积或仅用网格学习到的特征。

Conclusion: 在体积自监督学习中引入皮层表面几何可捕获更多可遗传变异，从而增加检出的位点数量。

Abstract: Existing genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of brain imaging provide predefined or deep-learning-derived imaging phenotypes, yet these phenotypes come from either volumetric scans or cortical surface meshes, so each captures only part of the heritable variation in brain anatomy. Here we introduce MEVA (Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder), a self-supervised framework that encodes voxel-level image intensity together with cortical mesh geometry, including curvature and cortical thickness at each surface vertex, into one shared set of imaging features. Combining the mesh and volumetric inputs in MEVA yields modest performance gains in age and sex prediction over models that use either input alone. When these features serve as phenotypes for GWAS in the UK Biobank, they reveal more genome-wide significant loci than features learned from volumes alone or from meshes alone. These results suggest that adding cortical surface geometry to volumetric self-supervised learning captures additional heritable variation and so increases the number of loci detected.

</details>


### [158] [Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02117)
*Sophia Sirko-Galouchenko,Monika Wysoczanska,Andrei Bursuc,Nicolas Thome,Spyros Gidaris*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多模态大模型的新型在线自蒸馏方法，通过为教师模型提供文本化的空间定位引导，无需人工标注或外部教师，即可实现合成的场景到真实感知任务的迁移提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏在多模态大模型（MLLM）上的应用尚不充分；已有的利用特权视觉信息（如图像裁剪）的方法局限于需要视觉放大的任务，且依赖人工标注的定位数据或外部教师模型，难以扩展和免标注。

Method: 面向 MLLM 的在线自蒸馏：教师模型接收额外的文本化、空间定位引导，明确指出与查询相关的视觉元素；使用程序化生成的场景（自动获得物体身份与空间坐标）实现可扩展、免标注的后训练。教师据此定位并整合多个相关图像区域的证据，学生仅凭图像和问题学习复现该行为。

Result: 在多个模型上，计数、文档与图表理解等基准性能一致提升；尽管后训练仅使用合成场景，改进可迁移至真实世界感知基准，在 CVBench、V*、ZoomBench、BLINK、HR-Bench、MME-RealWorld 上平均提升 3.23 个点。

Conclusion: 空间定位的特权信息可通过在线自蒸馏激发更广泛的感知能力，实现远超后训练任务与数据分布的合成到真实迁移。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that benefit from such visual zooming and require either human-annotated grounding data or external teacher models. We introduce a different form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs that provides the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance identifying the visual elements relevant to a query. We use procedurally generated scenes with automatically available object identities and spatial coordinates, enabling scalable and annotation-free post-training. The teacher uses this spatial guidance to locate and integrate evidence from multiple relevant image regions, while the student learns to reproduce the resulting behavior from the image and question alone. Our approach consistently improves performance on counting, document and chart understanding benchmarks across multiple models. Importantly, although post-training uses only synthetic scenes, the resulting improvements transfer to real-world perception benchmarks, yielding a 3.23-point gain in average performance across CVBench, V*, ZoomBench, BLINK, HR-Bench, and MME-RealWorld. These results show that spatially grounded privileged information can induce broader perceptual capabilities through on-policy self-distillation, enabling substantial synthetic-to-real transfer beyond the task and data distribution used for post-training. Project page: https://github.com/sirkosophia/Where-OPD

</details>


### [159] [Harnessing Domain Specialists in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02123)
*Damiano Marsili,Raphi Kang,Aditya Mehta,Pietro Perona,Georgia Gkioxari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现多模态MoE中的专家自发形成跨模态和领域的语义专业化，并提出ExpertLens方法直接从预训练权重中识别领域专家，实现高效的多模态适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究MoE的稀疏计算是否会在多模态场景中催生涌现的内在组织，即专家是否会在未显式训练模块化的情况下形成语义专业化，并利用这种结构实现高效适配。

Method: 提出ExpertLens，一种无数据方法，通过将路由器权重解码为语义上有意义的词汇token，直接从预训练模型权重中识别领域专业化专家，并据此选择性微调与目标领域相关的专家。

Result: 在数学、医学和遥感任务中，ExpertLens达到或超过全量微调的效果，仅更新21.7-47.0%的模型参数，平均训练加速4.0倍，且在适配性能和训练效率上均优于LoRA。

Conclusion: 为提升效率而引入的稀疏性能够催生语义模块化，这种模块化可直接用于高效适配，表明稀疏结构具有超越计算效率的实用价值。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse computation, routing each token through only a small subset of experts. In this work, we explore whether this sparsity gives rise to emergent intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs. We find that experts develop strong semantic specialization across modalities and domains despite not being explicitly trained for modularity. Building on this structure, we introduce ExpertLens, a data-free method that identifies domain-specialized experts directly from pretrained model weights by decoding router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens. We leverage this specialization for efficient multimodal adaptation by selectively fine-tuning experts relevant to a target domain. Across math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, ExpertLens matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating only 21.7 - 47.0% of model parameters and achieving a 4.0x average training speedup, and outperforms LoRA in both adaptation performance and training efficiency. These results show that sparsity introduced for efficiency can give rise to semantic modularity that is directly useful for efficient adaptation.

</details>


### [160] [MIRTO: a registration-gated, multiverse-tested evaluation protocol for unsupervised anomaly segmentation in brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02136)
*Negin Kafee Hernashki,Soumick Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MIRTO评估协议，将脑MRI无监督异常检测（UAD）中常被忽略的评估选择（配准、阈值设定、假阳性预算、指标、聚合与病灶定义）显式化，并在312例BraTS 2020数据上对四种UAD方法进行15,552种可辩护评估流水线的配对比较，揭示评估选择对排名结论的影响远大于方法本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑MRI的无监督异常检测方法通常仅凭单一分数排名，但该分数依赖于很少被报告的评估选择：异常图与参考的配准方式、阈值如何设定、在什么数据上设定、采用何种假阳性预算、指标、聚合方式与病灶定义。这些隐含选择可能主导结论，导致方法间的排名不可靠。

Method: MIRTO协议：用配准检查约束每次比较的几何一致性，并配合已知检验效力的无标签诊断；仅在验证集上设定阈值，并报告测试集上实际实现的假阳性体积；在15,552种可辩护的评估流水线上重复每次比较；附加配对受试者自助法区间并进行多重性控制。应用于四种在相同健康数据上训练、在312例BraTS 2020受试者上测试的UAD方法，检验了九个假设。

Result: 存储图与参考之间的轴序不匹配使扩散模型的体素AUROC从0.873降至0.583，而切片级AUROC几乎不变。在每一指标内，方法可解释体素AUROC与AUPRC至少0.95的方差、Dice 0.77的方差，但仅解释病灶敏感度0.14的方差——后者由病灶定义与命中准则主导。一个在验证阈值下显著的Dice优势在等实际假阳性负担下消失，其精确归因于阈值迁移。对REFLECT的潜在聚合做免训练改动，在等负担下将Dice提升0.052。因同一队列既用于开发协议又用于评估，所有推断均为探索性。

Conclusion: 脑MRI UAD的排名结论高度依赖评估流水线的隐含选择，甚至可因轴序等几何问题而被颠覆。MIRTO通过显式化并穷举这些选择，提供了更稳健、可归因的评估方式；但因协议开发与评估共用同一队列，其推断应视为探索性而非确证性。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. Applied to four UAD methods trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects, MIRTO showed that an axis-order mismatch between stored maps and the reference lowered a diffusion model's voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583 whilst barely moving its slice-level AUROC. Within each metric, the method explained at least 0.95 of the variance in voxel AUROC and AUPRC and 0.77 in Dice, but only 0.14 in lesion sensitivity, where the lesion definition and hit criterion dominated. A Dice advantage that was significant at validation thresholds vanished at equal realised false-positive burden, and an exact identity attributes it to threshold transfer. A training-free change to REFLECT's latent aggregation raised Dice at equal burden by 0.052. Nine hypotheses were tested against explicit criteria; because the same cohort served to develop the protocol, all inference is exploratory.

</details>


### [161] [Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02148)
*Mohammed Irfan Kurpath,Jaseel Muhammad Kaithakkodan,Sahal Shaji Mullappilly,Ivan Laptev,Hisham Cholakkal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Omni-Embed-Mini，一个 0.9B 参数的全模态嵌入模型，将文本、语音、音频、图像、视频和富文本文档映射到统一余弦空间，且不更新任何文本侧参数，保护文本检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展文本嵌入模型到新模态通常会损害文本检索质量，而现有全模态嵌入器依靠数十亿参数来补偿这一退化，代价高昂。

Method: 关键洞察是教师信号无需独立嵌入模型：每个媒体样本配有稠密级联字幕，教师目标即冻结骨干对字幕自身的嵌入。教师与学生共享同一骨干权重，处于逐字节相同的几何空间，仅需轻量投影器与模态编码器上的分阶段 LoRA 适配器即可对齐。训练结合 Matryoshka SigLIP 对比损失与在线混合难负样本挖掘器，负样本随编码器提升而增强。该方案通过换用原生视觉语言骨干可迁移至 2.3B 变体。

Result: Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B 的文本权重与骨干逐比特一致，训练不会导致文本检索退化（MTEB-v2 BEIR-8 上 49.57 nDCG@10），同时扩展至五个额外模态，且比所有对比的开源全模态嵌入器小约 2.7 倍至 9.5 倍。2.3B 变体与闭源 gemini-embedding-2 具竞争力，在全模态平均上略占优势。

Conclusion: 轻量投影器加分阶段 LoRA 可在冻结共享骨干下实现全模态对齐，保护文本检索并大幅压缩模型规模，且方案可扩展至更大变体。模型、代码、数据与评测框架已公开。

Abstract: Extending a text embedding model to new modalities typically degrades text retrieval quality, and existing omni-modal embedders compensate with multi-billion parameters. We present Omni-Embed-Mini, a 0.9B-parameter model that maps text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into a single shared cosine space without updating any text-side parameter. Our key insight is that the teacher signal requires no separate embedding model: each media sample is paired with a dense cascaded caption, and the teacher target is simply the frozen backbone's own embedding of that caption. Because teacher and student share the same backbone weights, they inhabit byte-identical geometry, and lightweight projectors plus phased LoRA adapters on the modality encoders suffice for alignment. Training combines a Matryoshka SigLIP contrastive loss with an online hybrid hard-negative miner whose negatives sharpen as the encoder improves. The recipe carries over to a 2.3B variant by swapping in a native vision-language backbone. Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B keeps its text weights bit-identical to the backbone, so training cannot regress text retrieval (49.57 nDCG@10 on MTEB-v2 BEIR-8), while extending it to five additional modalities, and is ~2.7x to 9.5x smaller than every open omni embedder we compare against. The 2.3B variant is competitive with the closed gemini-embedding-2, edging ahead of it on the overall-modality average. Models, code, data and evaluation harness are on our project page: https://omniembed.cvmbzuai.com

</details>


### [162] [MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02153)
*Yiwen Zhang,Haocheng Xi,Michael Tian-Yue Liu,Alexei A. Efros,Hadar Averbuch-Elor,Qianqian Wang,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MosaiChunk时空记忆机制，通过组合历史KV条目保留视频生成中长期视觉细节，并引入RememBench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程自回归视频生成受有限上下文窗口限制，物体或场景移出上下文后，其细粒度视觉细节会丢失且难以恢复。

Method: 基于冻结视频生成器可直接消费非连续历史KV的观察，保持生成器固定，仅学习轻量路由器，在固定活跃记忆预算下决定将哪些历史片段纳入镶嵌记忆中。

Result: 在T2V和I2V设置下，MosaiChunk在相同记忆预算下相比滑动窗口推理和整块检索，持续提升重访一致性。同时提出RememBench基准，包含提示驱动的T2V和相机驱动的I2V长时程重访划分。

Conclusion: MosaiChunk能有效缓解长时程视频生成中因上下文窗口有限导致的视觉细节丢失问题，提升重访一致性。

Abstract: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation is limited by a finite context window. When an object or scene falls out of context, its fine-grained visual details may be lost and difficult to recover upon reappearance. To retain access to such visual details, we introduce MosaiChunk, a spatio-temporal memory mechanism that composes a mosaic of selected historical key-value (KV) entries across space and time. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a frozen video generator can directly consume such non-contiguous historical KV and recover the corresponding visual content. We therefore keep the generator fixed and learn only a lightweight router that determines which historical sections to include in the mosaic under a fixed active-memory budget. We further introduce RememBench, a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven text-to-video (T2V) and camera-driven image-to-video (I2V) splits. Our experiments show that MosaiChunk consistently improves revisit consistency over both sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets, across both T2V and I2V settings.

</details>


### [163] [4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02160)
*Wei Cao,Hao Zhang,Vikram Voleti,Yuqun Wu,Mallikarjun B R,Shimon Vainer,Mark Boss,Yaoyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 4Director是一个以显式4D场景表示为条件的视频世界模型，将每个物体从输入图像重建为规范网格并按每帧刚性变换运动，通过深度视频和Motion Adapter生成具备视角一致性的视频，在视觉质量和相机/物体控制上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业视频制作需要对相机和物体运动进行精确控制，但现有方法只能粗略控制物体：基于图像平面的线索在深度和旋转上存在歧义，而3D轨迹和blob缺乏完整几何并在视角变化时失去一致性。因此需要一个能提供直观3D控制接口并保持几何一致性的表示方法。

Method: 提出4Director，以显式4D场景表示为条件的视频世界模型：每个物体从输入图像一次性重建为规范网格，通过每帧一个预设刚性变换进行移动，从而避免未观测几何在每帧被独立重新生成。将受控场景渲染为深度视频，并引入Motion Adapter将几何脚手架转化为视频，同时合成视角一致的外观、光照和非刚性动态。训练方面构建了RealCOD-Rigid数据集（20,774个片段，由自动流程标注刚性3D场景）。还提出Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU)指标，联合评估对预设物体运动的遵循程度和物体身份的保持。

Result: 实验表明4Director在视觉质量以及相机和物体控制方面持续优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 通过显式4D场景表示和Motion Adapter，4Director实现了精确的相机与物体运动控制，并提供新数据集与评估指标，验证了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Precise control over camera and object motion is essential for professional video production. Existing methods control objects only coarsely, through image-plane cues that are ambiguous in depth and rotation or through 3D tracks and blobs that lack complete geometry and lose consistency across viewpoint changes. We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame. This representation provides an intuitive 3D control interface and prevents unobserved geometry from being regenerated independently in every frame. We render the controlled scene as a depth video and introduce a Motion Adapter that transforms this geometric scaffold into video while synthesizing view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics. For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline. We further introduce Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU), which jointly evaluates adherence to prescribed object motion and preservation of object identity. Experiments demonstrate that 4Director consistently outperforms prior methods in visual quality and in camera and object control.

</details>


### [164] [World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02162)
*Hyunwook Choi,Dahyun Chung,Hyunsung Kim,Siyoon Jin,Jinhyeok Choi,Junyoung Seo,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 World Observer，通过将“观察”与“行动”解耦，用全景观察者持续生成视角范围外的世界演化，使物体离开视角后仍能保持状态与动态，并在重新进入时反映更新状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型以行动者为中心，一旦物体离开当前视角，就失去其演化证据，导致物体重新进入视野时状态和动态无法正确保持。论文希望解决视角外区域的持续观测与演化建模问题。

Method: 方法将观察与行动解耦：联合生成一个视角内行动者视角以及一个或多个观察指定世界区域的全景观察者。行动者与观察者通过从共享全景源进行变换来实现显式几何对应，并引入高分辨率视角参考的 Observer Sink，在物体重新进入时恢复细节外观。观察者可自由布置、扩展到多个位置，并可由控制信号驱动以引导视角外演化。

Result: 论文引入世界空间指标以及涵盖真实与合成场景的基准来评估视角外演化。实验表明，World Observer 显著提升视角外动态表现，同时在视觉保真度、相机控制和 3D 一致性方面保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过解耦观察与行动并引入全景观察者与 Observer Sink，World Observer 能有效建模视角外世界的持续演化，为视频世界模型提供更完整的全局动态建模能力。

Abstract: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.

</details>


### [165] [Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02180)
*Jiahan Zhang,Chaohao Yang,Namitha Guruprasad,Vivekjyoti Banerjee,Trong-Tung Nguyen,Alan Yuille,Anand Bhattad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenCine 将单张图像提升为可编辑的 3D 场景支架，让艺术家在统一世界坐标系下联合编辑相机与前景物体的 3D 运动，并通过投影引导图把控制信息传给预训练视频模型，实现相机相对运动的一致性与可控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成主要依赖 2D 运动轨迹或稀疏拖拽信号，这些控制在相机与物体同时运动时存在歧义——同一 2D 轨迹可能对应多种不同 3D 运动。因此需要一种能显式建模 3D 相机与物体运动并联合控制的方法。

Method: 方法上，作者先将单张图像提升为可编辑的 3D 场景支架；艺术家指定相机路径，并用局部 3D 运动手柄移动选定前景区域，多个手柄可独立驱动主体不同部位，形成分段刚性的非刚性运动近似，无需物理模拟器或类别先验。随后把这些控制投影为引导图：记录受控区域在每帧的位置，为每个手柄分配跨帧固定颜色，并在与背景相同的世界坐标系中编码受控点的当前 3D 位置。训练时，从真实视频的运动中恢复控制信号，并利用合成视频的几何与轨迹真值，在预训练 Wan 模型上训练一个轻量引导分支与 LoRA 适配器。

Result: 实验表明，该方法能实现一致的相机相对运动，在视角变化下具有更好的几何一致性，并在多样化的真实场景中表现出强可控性。

Conclusion: GenCine 通过将相机与前景运动统一到 3D 世界坐标系并编码为引导图，为预训练视频模型提供了无歧义、可解释且易扩展的运动控制接口，验证了 3D 支架式控制在真实场景视频生成中的有效性。

Abstract: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. These maps record where the controlled regions appear in each frame, assign each handle a fixed color across frames and encode the current 3D positions of its controlled points in the same world coordinate system as the background. This lets us describe object motion relative to the scene even as the camera moves. For training, we recover controls from the motion observed in real videos and use ground-truth geometry and trajectories from synthetic videos. We train a lightweight guidance branch and LoRA adapters on a pretrained Wan model to follow these controls. Our experiments show consistent camera-relative motion, improved geometric consistency under viewpoint changes, and strong controllability across diverse real-world scenes.

</details>


### [166] [OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02181)
*Haibo Wang,Jiteng Mu,Jialu Li,Jingru Yi,Yuanjun Xiong,Jianming Zhang,Lifu Huang,Mingze Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniSeek，一个将全模态大模型改造为具备原生工具调用能力的主动式多轮推理智能体的框架，让模型在推理过程中动态决定"看"或"听"以及时间窗口，检索稀疏但关键的多模态证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Omni-LLM 通常在一次前向传播中被动处理整段音视频序列，缺乏主动获取证据的能力，导致在长上下文中难以高效定位关键的多模态信息。作者希望让证据获取成为推理过程的一部分。

Method: 1) 构建数据引擎合成 OmniTraj-170K，包含交错音视频证据的多跳思维链轨迹；2) 先用这些轨迹监督，注入多轮工具使用行为；3) 再用两阶段可验证奖励强化学习优化策略；4) 引入 Audio-Visual Necessity 目标，奖励真正依赖双模态的轨迹，抑制单模态捷径。

Result: 在广泛基准上的大量实验表明，OmniSeek 学到了自适应跨模态证据检索能力，并持续提升音视频推理性能。

Conclusion: 将主动式、多轮、可验证奖励的工具调用范式引入全模态推理，能有效增强模型在长上下文中的跨模态证据定位与推理能力，为 Omni-LLM 的智能体化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We present OmniSeek, an agentic framework that transforms an Omni Large Language Model (Omni-LLM) into an active, multi-turn reasoning agent with native tool use. Rather than passively processing an entire audio-visual sequence in a single forward pass, OmniSeek makes evidence acquisition part of the reasoning process: it dynamically decides whether to look or listen, and over which temporal window, to retrieve sparse but critical evidence across different modalities within long contexts. Through an iterative multi-turn protocol, the retrieved raw audio or visual segments are appended back into the context to support subsequent reasoning. To cold-start this capability, we build a data engine that synthesizes OmniTraj-170K, a corpus of multi-hop Chain-of-Thought trajectories with interleaved audio and visual evidence. We first supervise the model on these trajectories to instill multi-turn tool-use behavior, and then further optimize the policy via a two-stage reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Moreover, we introduce an Audio-Visual Necessity objective that explicitly rewards successful trajectories whose reasoning depends on both modalities, discouraging single-modality shortcuts. Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that OmniSeek learns adaptive cross-modal evidence seeking and consistently improves audio-visual reasoning performance.

</details>


### [167] [DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02188)
*Zhengming Yu,Junkun Yuan,Haotian Yang,Gordon Guocheng Qian,Yizhi Wang,Angtian Wang,Yiding Yang,Bo Liu,Xin Li,Wenping Wang,Chongyang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DMAD将分布匹配蒸馏重新表述为分类问题，通过判别器直接学习对数密度比，无需辅助扩散模型，在少步生成任务上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMD依赖额外辅助扩散模型拟合学生演化分布，带来额外的内存和计算开销。本文旨在避免这种辅助分数拟合，直接学习所需的对数密度比。

Method: 提出DMAD，将分布匹配作为对抗蒸馏：在共享骨干上使用两个判别器头，分别区分真实数据与教师样本同学生样本，通过logits上的线性损失训练学生；并证明在判别器最优时这些损失恢复DMD的分布匹配梯度；进一步提出基于gap的重加权，依据真实数据头中真实样本与教师样本的经验logit gap自适应调整不同噪声水平下的教师监督。

Result: ImageNet-64x64单步FID 1.04；COCO-10K四步SDXL FID 14.47；四步Wan2.1-T2V-14B的VBench总分85.15，均为对比少步方法及多步教师最优；MiniMax-H3-33B四步学生在联合音视频生成上人类偏好率优于DMD2 (79.1%) 和rCM (84.6%)。

Conclusion: DMAD通过分类式对抗蒸馏直接学习对数密度比，消除了辅助扩散模型的需求，并在图像与视频生成任务上超越少步基线及多步教师。

Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student from the difference between separately estimated target and student scores, so it must keep an auxiliary diffusion model fitted to the student's evolving distribution at extra memory and computation cost. We introduce DMAD, Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation, which recasts distribution matching as classification and learns the required log-density ratios directly. Two discriminator heads on a shared backbone distinguish real data and teacher samples from the student's, and linear losses on their logits train the student without auxiliary score fitting. We prove that at the discriminator optimum these losses recover the distribution-matching gradient underlying DMD, through the classical identity linking discriminator logits to log-density ratios. We further introduce gap-based reweighting, which adapts teacher supervision across noise levels from the real-data head's empirical logit gap between real and teacher samples. DMAD reaches a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 1.04 with one-step generation on ImageNet-64x64, 14.47 with four-step SDXL on COCO-10K, and a VBench total score of 85.15 with four-step Wan2.1-T2V-14B, the best values among the compared few-step methods and the multi-step teachers. On MiniMax-H3-33B, our four-step student achieves overall human preference rates of 79.1% over DMD2 and 84.6% over rCM for joint audio-video generation, excluding ties. Our code, models and demos are available at https://yzmblog.github.io/projects/DMAD.

</details>


### [168] [HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02197)
*Tahira Kazimi,Shubhankar Borse,Munawar Hayat,Fatih Porikli,Pinar Yanardag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HiPhy层次化物理对齐强化学习框架，通过局部时间动态约束与全局场景物理语义一致性双目标，解决视频生成中多物理原理同时遵循的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉保真度高、有望成为通用世界模拟器，但在遵循物理规律方面仍存在不足，尤其当同一视频中需要多个物理原理协同作用时问题更突出。现有方法大多只关注单一物理原理，忽略了多原理交互。

Method: 提出HiPhy（Hierarchical Physical Alignment）强化学习框架，采用双层目标：局部强化单个物理原理的时间动态，全局保证整个场景的物理与语义一致性；同时构建50K提示词数据集及MultiPhyBench基准，覆盖多种共发物理事件。

Result: HiPhy显著优于先前方法与基线，在多个基准上大幅提升物理常识与语义对齐，尤其在多物理原理并发的场景中提升最大，而竞争方法在此类场景中退化最严重。

Conclusion: 通过层次化物理对齐与多原理数据集/基准，HiPhy有效提升了视频生成对物理规律的遵循能力，特别适用于多物理原理并发场景。

Abstract: Video generation models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and have strong potential to become general-purpose world simulators. Despite this progress, they still fail to generate videos which adhere to laws of physics. The problem becomes even more apparent in realistic settings where multiple physical principles must work together within the same video; for example, "a balloon floating upward while steam rises from a pot" requires buoyancy and fluid dynamics to unfold coherently and simultaneously. Yet existing methods largely ignore multi-principle interactions, focusing on a single principle per video. We propose HiPhy (Hierarchical Physical Alignment), a reinforcement learning framework that grounds video generation in physical laws through a dual-level objective: locally enforcing the temporal dynamics of individual physical principles, and globally ensuring the physical and semantic coherence of the entire scene. To support multi-principle generation, we construct a 50K-prompt dataset and introduce a prompt benchmark MultiPhyBench, spanning a diverse range of co-occurring physical events. Our experiments show that HiPhy significantly outperforms prior methods and baselines, improving physical commonsense and semantic alignment significantly across various benchmarks, with the largest gains on scenes involving multiple concurrent physical principles where competing methods degrade most sharply.

</details>


### [169] [SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02201)
*Tianjiao Yu,Xinzhuo Li,Yifan Shen,Ying Shen,Kiet A. Nguyen,Adheesh Sunil Juvekar,Ismini Lourentzou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SILSA 提出一种基于滑动窗口切片隐变量的拓扑感知三维生成框架，用紧凑切片令牌替代昂贵体素令牌，实现单阶段生成并显著降低生成成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高分辨率三维生成依赖体素隐变量和多阶段流程（先预测结构再合成局部几何），导致连续表面被碎片化为大量局部令牌、生成成本高，且对薄结构或高连通形状的拓扑一致性较差。

Method: SILSA 沿三个标准轴使用固定数量的重叠切片表示形状，每个令牌概括局部深度窗口以保持截面连续性并支持单阶段 rectified-flow 生成。Slice VAE 将带方向的表面采样编码为多轴切片隐变量，并用稀疏体解码器重建；Volumetric Anchor Lattice 通过共享三维工作空间协调各方向切片流。同时引入切片级拓扑监督，匹配持久性图并对齐相邻切片间的 Betti 转变。

Result: 相比最强基线，PSNR 提升 8.7%，覆盖率提升 5.96 个绝对百分点，Betti 误差降低 9.2%；令牌数比次最紧凑基线少 70.0%，比稀疏或分层令牌器少 98% 以上，训练内存降低 40.4%，推理时间降低 58.5%。定性结果显示薄结构、重复部件和长程连通性保持更好。

Conclusion: SILSA 通过紧凑切片隐变量与拓扑监督，在提升结构保真度的同时大幅降低生成成本，验证了拓扑感知切片表示在三维生成中的有效性。

Abstract: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. A Slice VAE encodes oriented surface samples into multi-axis slice latents and reconstructs them with a sparse volumetric decoder, while a Volumetric Anchor Lattice coordinates directional slice streams through a shared 3D workspace. To preserve structural correctness, we introduce slice-level topology supervision that matches persistence diagrams and aligns Betti transitions across neighboring slices. Experiments show that SILSA improves structural fidelity while substantially reducing generation cost. SILSA improves PSNR by $8.7\%$, coverage by $5.96$ absolute points, and Betti error by $9.2\%$ over the strongest baseline, while using $70.0\%$ fewer tokens than the next-most compact baseline and over $98\%$ fewer tokens than sparse or hierarchical tokenizers, effectively reducing training memory by $40.4\%$ and inference time by $58.5\%$. Qualitative results further show improved preservation of thin structures, repeated components, and long-range connectivity.

</details>


### [170] [Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02203)
*Sihan Xu,Ji Xie,Zilin Wang,Hui Shen,Stella X. Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NEPA：用Transformer预测下一连续嵌入作为扩散Transformer的条件，在每个去噪步重新计算，使条件信号自适应噪声状态，ImageNet 256×256上FID达1.32。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散Transformer中，类标签或文本提示只嵌入一次，整个去噪过程复用同一条件，无法随当前噪声状态自适应。

Method: NEPA训练Transformer预测序列中的下一个连续嵌入；生成时干净图像嵌入视为条件与噪声图像之后的下一个嵌入，用Multi-Embedding Prediction一次性预测全部嵌入，再通过Embedding Conditioned Generation让DiT以其为条件并在每步去噪重新计算。

Result: 在类条件ImageNet 256×256上研究了生成器条件、Multi-Embedding Prediction设计及两模型扩展性；结合REPA的最终模型NEPA-DiT-XL以约REPA三分之一的训练算力达到FID 1.32。

Conclusion: 用预测嵌入替代静态条件可提升扩散Transformer性能，虽每步增加第二网络开销，但显著提高算力效率。

Abstract: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.

</details>


### [171] [ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02205)
*Zheng-Hui Huang,Guixu Lin,Yu-Ju Tsai,Jian-Kai Zhu,Fengbo Lan,Yu-Lun Liu,Yung-Yu Chuang,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PROWBench，一个针对可编程世界模型视觉忠实度的基准，包含170个程序化情节和600个代理视频，用于评估生成视频与程序执行事件的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可编程世界模型将可执行动力学与视觉生成分离，但现有基准很少测试对细粒度、程序指定世界事件的视觉忠实度，因此需要新的评估方法。

Method: PROWBench记录实体状态和时间戳事件（包括视野外事件）作为可重放世界记录，渲染同步视图与代理表示；提供可扩展框架构建场景、控制行为，支持粗3D、边界框等多种表示，覆盖第一和第三人称视角，部分情节含多视图同步观测。

Result: 基准评估实体控制、长时程记忆，并采用两个基于VLM的指标：Logic-Render Alignment和Interaction Success Rate，衡量对预设时间线和引擎记录事件视觉实现的遵循程度。

Conclusion: PROWBench填补了可编程世界模型在细粒度程序事件视觉忠实度评估上的空白，为下一代游戏引擎提供更严格的评测基础。

Abstract: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.

</details>


### [172] [One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02207)
*Ramazan Fazylov,Stamatis Lefkimmiatis,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GALA，通过线性近似将预训练 3D Gaussian 头像模型的动画解耦为浅层系数预测器加线性混合，大幅降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D Gaussian 头像渲染快，但实时动画受限于高昂的神经推理开销。作者发现预训练头像模型的动画可被"身份无关的 blendshapes 线性组合"很好近似，从而为加速提供理论依据。

Method: GALA（Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation）是一种蒸馏方法：用浅层系数预测器（浅层 MLP）预测 blendshape 系数，再做线性混合，替代逐帧的繁重神经解码。基底的构建采用块局部 PCA，并在渲染感知度量与内存预算约束下进行。该方法无需重新训练原模型，可适用于多种动画架构。

Result: 在三种不同的头像模型（面部表情与带衣物动态的全身动画）上验证：蒸馏可泛化到未见身份，CPU 动画成本最多降低三个数量级，同时保留大部分渲染质量；帧率在移动设备上可达 60fps。

Conclusion: 结果证实了学习到的头像表示具有共享的线性结构，并实现了高效且准确的实时动画，为预训练 Gaussian 头像模型的部署提供实用加速方案。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

</details>


### [173] [Sphere Encoder 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02208)
*Kaiyu Yue,Sean McLeish,Ruchit Rawal,Brian Bartoldson,Menglin Jia,Tom Goldstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Sphere Encoder 2 通过解决原始 Sphere Encoder 的两个生成质量局限，在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的同时大幅提升图像生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始 Sphere Encoder 在隐空间中解码随机球面点来生成图像，但存在两个降低生成质量的局限：随机点集中在赤道附近而训练的旋转从未覆盖该区域，形成缺口限制单步生成；像素级重建损失促使解码器对合理图像取平均，导致图像模糊、缺乏高频细节。

Method: 本文提出 Sphere Encoder 2，针对上述两个局限进行改进，同时保持自编码器的快速与简洁特性。

Result: Sphere Encoder 2 显著提升了图像生成质量，并保持自编码器的速度与简洁性。模型已在 GitHub 上发布。

Conclusion: 通过解决赤道点集中与像素级重建损失导致的模糊问题，Sphere Encoder 2 有效提升了生成质量，延续了自编码器高效简洁的优势。

Abstract: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at \href{https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}{github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}.

</details>


### [174] [Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02210)
*Sophia Feldman,Assaf Shocher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将几何变换与其逆约束嵌入扩散采样过程的图像生成方法，可生成类《Print Gallery》的自指递归构图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Escher 的《Print Gallery》展现了自指递归几何，已有数学分析将其与共形幂映射联系起来。作者希望借助冻结的文本到图像扩散模型生成此类自指场景，但发现单纯提示词、事后变换或在采样中施加变换均无法保持递归结构的几何一致性。

Method: 针对不可逆图像变换 T，构造满足 Penrose 恒等式 T T† T = T 的广义逆 T†，使 T T† 成为几何可行图像上的幂等投影；再将去噪步骤与 T 和 T† 交错（braid），在源空间发展未扭曲场景，在变换空间优化其外观与连接。

Result: 生成了类《Print Gallery》的构图并探索了更多变换形式；场景与其畸变在采样过程中协同发展，而非对成品图像事后扭曲，从而获得连接更好的递归结构。

Conclusion: 将变换及其广义逆融入扩散采样过程，可有效生成几何自洽的自指递归图像，为可控几何生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: I don't think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein's curved universe.'' So wrote M.C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery. Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map $z \mapsto z^α$, $α\in \mathbb{C}$. Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may "repair" the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse $T^\dagger$ of the non-invertible image transformation $T$, adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity $TT^\dagger T = T$ makes $TT^\dagger$ an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with $T$ and $T^\dagger$: source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery-like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [175] [Supporting Perspective Acquisition and Opinion Formation on Societal Issues Through AI-Generated Japanese Rap Battle Debates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01179)
*Ryota Mibayashi,Toru Urakawa,Dai Takanashi,Tomoya Morohoshi,Kanata Yamagishi,Ryuho Sekikawa,Yasuhiko Nishimura,Yuta Takeuchi,Hideaki Tamori,Takehiro Yamamoto,Hidenari Kiyomitsu,Hiroaki Ohshima*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 研究探索用GPT生成的简短说唱对战式辩论（约1.5分钟）能否促进社会议题的观点获取与意见形成；6人用户研究显示，参与者提出的观点与讨论点数量近乎翻倍，52.5%的案例中重新考虑或改变了立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察对立观点之间的辩论有助于获取多元视角与形成有依据的判断，但传统辩论耗时耗力、可及性受限，因此需要探索更轻量、易获取的替代形式。

Method: 将辩论内容改写为说唱对战式（押韵对辩、保留论证对话结构），使用GPT-5.4-mini自动生成，并配以合成语音与网页观看界面；以全日本初高中辩论锦标赛的社会议题为主题生成40场辩论，邀请6名参与者进行用户研究评估教育效果。

Result: 观看约1.5分钟的说唱对战式辩论后，参与者识别出的观点与讨论点数量近乎翻倍；在评估案例中有52.5%出现了立场的重新考虑或改变。

Conclusion: 即使是简短的AI生成说唱对战式辩论，也能有效支持社会议题上的视角获取与意见形成。

Abstract: Acquiring diverse perspectives and forming informed opinions on societal issues are essential for critical thinking and informed decision-making. Although observing debates between opposing viewpoints can promote perspective acquisition, conventional debates require substantial time and human resources, limiting their accessibility. This study investigates whether brief AI-generated rap battle-style debates can support perspective acquisition and opinion formation on societal issues. Rap battles are debate-style performances in which opposing viewpoints are expressed through rhymed verses, making them engaging while preserving the structure of argumentative dialogue. To conduct this investigation, we automatically generated rap battle-style debates using GPT-5.4-mini and presented them to participants with synthesized audio through a web-based viewing interface. We evaluated the educational effectiveness of this approach through a user study involving six participants who viewed 40 debates generated from topics on societal issues used in the All Japan Junior and Senior High School Debate Championships. The results showed that watching approximately 1.5 minute rap battle-style debates nearly doubled the number of opinions and discussion points identified by participants. Furthermore, participants reconsidered or changed their stances in 52.5% of the evaluated cases. These findings demonstrate that even brief AI-generated rap battle-style debates can effectively support perspective acquisition and opinion formation on societal issues.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [176] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将反向项目反应理论（reverse IRT）引入药物基因组学药物反应分析，把癌症类型视为具有"耐药能力"的潜在被试、药物视为具有"规避难度"的项目，并在GDSC2大规模数据上验证了其方法学稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物反应数据在评估时普遍存在碎片化与缺失问题，简单的平均值统计难以恢复真实的潜在排序；作者希望借助心理测量学中的IRT框架，将癌症类型的耐药性与药物的广谱活性放到同一潜在尺度上估计，从而在数据不完整时获得更稳健的推断。

Method: 将癌症类型建模为潜在"被试"（耐药能力）、药物建模为"项目"（规避难度），在GDSC2数据库的242,036条药物敏感性测量上拟合反向IRT模型；在四种缺失机制下（MCAR、癌症偏向、药物偏向等）与简单平均法比较潜在排序恢复能力，并通过留出预测、Bootstrap置信区间及PRISM跨平台复现进行评估。

Result: 在60%缺失率下，MCAR、癌症偏向和药物偏向稀疏条件下reverse IRT相对简单平均法的排序恢复优势为Δρ = +0.089至+0.095；在留出预测中，五种方法里IRT的Brier分数最优；Bootstrap显示28种癌症类型中有19种具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复现显示方向一致率为82%，但排序相关性较弱（ρ = 0.25）。

Conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于碎片化评估条件下的方法学稳健性，而非提供一个普适的临床耐药榜单；跨平台排序相关性较弱也提示其结论应限定于方法层面。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [177] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Adam的完整更新规则（含动量）解释为对角经验Fisher近似，并从几何角度测量其与真实自然梯度下降(NGD)的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是深度学习标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降的几何关系尚存未解问题。作者希望揭示Adam的实际优化能力是否源于对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪，还是其他因素。

Method: 将Adam的完整更新规则（包括动量）建模为受对角截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后影响的对角经验Fisher近似。采用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在四种损失景观上测量Adam与真实NGD的几何偏差：良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归和一个非凸小型神经网络。

Result: Adam的几何轨迹依赖于具体情境。在良态设置中偏差较低，但在病态条件下显著上升，在神经网络中失配达到约10³量级。较高的几何漂移与较慢的初始优化相关，但不会降低最终目标最小化效果——Adam始终能达到较低损失。此外，改进经验Fisher(iEF)比标准经验Fisher(EF)跟踪更稳定的路径，后者经常震荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源于结构性近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [178] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控消融实验，检验了频率坍缩注意力中滤波器形状的五种假设，发现带通结构（抑制DC与Nyquist）是关键，最优单尺度带通在段落尺度上取得稳定增益，而因果版本难以超越标准点积注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率坍缩注意力用学习频率上的带通滤波内积替代标准Q/K点积并取得显著提升，但何种滤波器形状最优及其原因尚不清楚，因此需要系统性检验滤波器的关键性质。

Method: 在字符级语言建模任务（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，测试关于DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率和多尺度覆盖的五种假设。

Result: (1) DC与Nyquist成分有害（val约2.0，等同相位随机化）；(2) 最优单尺度带宽sigma约2 bins，中心在段落尺度（约70 token），相对BASE-DOT增益+1.15 nats；(3) 可容许滤波器（零均值、墨西哥帽DOG m=2）同尺度优于非容许高斯，并部分抵御双边FFT泄漏；(4) 双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增大，窄带干净而宽带泄漏；(5) 字符尺度因果时域Morlet无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128 taps仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%）。

Conclusion: FourierQK在双向注意力（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因训练与推理均可获得全序列上下文；而自回归生成需要因果频谱变体（如MorletQK），即解码器式（如GPT）架构。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [179] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究将强化学习多示例学习（RL-MIL）、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络结合的多目标框架，用于学生风险预测。结果显示基线分类性能强，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式坍缩，偏好权重难以系统性地调节公平性-性能权衡。结论是仅靠偏好条件化不足以保证多目标可控，需要显式的梯度平衡、目标分离与稳定性机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现，既要求模型准确，又要求足够透明以支持有意义的干预；同时人口统计学信息会带来不公平预测的额外风险。因此需要兼顾准确性、可解释性与公平性的多目标建模方案。

Method: 提出多目标框架：用多示例学习（MIL）将每个学生表示为一袋弱标注交互，用强化学习智能体选择信息量高的实例供下游分类；引入对抗去偏以处理人口统计学带来的公平性问题；并评估两种超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。

Result: 底层RL-MIL基线分类性能强，但两种超网络扩展都出现模式坍缩：改变偏好权重几乎不能使模型沿预期的公平性-性能前沿系统移动。失败原因与目标支配、条件化机制中梯度传播微弱、以及动态生成参数之间的相互作用有关。

Conclusion: 公平目标可以嵌入可解释的RL-MIL流程中，但仅靠偏好条件化并不能保证多目标行为可控。稳健的公平RL-MIL需要显式的梯度平衡、目标分离与稳定性分析机制。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [180] [Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00049)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 短多项式程序可替代LLM中的SFU特殊函数运算以加速内核，在GB200任务中实现最高8.0%的训练步吞吐提升，且训练损失影响很小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU代际间矩阵、特殊函数与内存管线扩展速率不同，导致内核瓶颈随硬件演进而转移。FlashAttention-4已揭示Blackwell上注意力内部的这种不平衡，作者据此研究短多项式程序能否加速LLM中其他SFU运算。

Method: 先隔离比较原生PyTorch与打包FMA程序在FP16扫描下的表现（覆盖L2与HBM驻留工作集）；再用3阶或4阶BF16多项式程序替换原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU，应用于四个GB200集成任务（dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention、routed-expert SwiGLU）。程序结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入与消费内核内的打包算术。

Result: 隔离路径在L2提升1.19–2.19x、HBM提升1.00–1.70x。dense-SiLU、tanh-softcapped-attention、routed-expert替换分别提升完整训练步吞吐2.7%、2.9%、8.0%；sigmoid-attention替换提升完整注意力前向7.4%、完整GPU步0.3%。同检查点开放权重消融与每任务一次配对预训练比较显示，约1000亿token时最终平滑训练损失差异（多项式减原生）在-0.107至+0.079之间。

Conclusion: 短多项式程序能在不显著损害模型行为的前提下替代多个SFU运算并带来实际训练吞吐提升，是应对GPU代际瓶颈转移的有效手段。

Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

</details>


### [181] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SW-KAN，使用定义在半无限域(0,∞)的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式构建KAN，通过exp-tanh映射桥接域差距，在三项递推下实现O(N)高效评估，在图像分类与函数逼近中取得更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始KAN用B样条计算开销大；现有多项式KAN变体虽缓解了开销，却引入了被忽视的根本问题——无界实数输入与正交多项式基的有界或半无限支撑之间的域不匹配。作者希望用天然定义在半无限域上的正交多项式来消除这一不匹配，同时保持数值稳定与计算高效。

Method: 1) 采用定义在(0,∞)上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式作为KAN边上的可学习单变量函数；2) 设计平滑的exponential-of-tanh映射，将无界输入稳定映射到半无限域，并保持良态的梯度；3) 利用数值稳定的三项递推关系，在不调用特殊函数的情况下以O(N)复杂度评估多项式展开；4) 引入可学习的q参数，配合对数正态权重结构形成独特的归纳偏置。

Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近两类任务上，SW-KAN实现了优于现有多项式KAN基线的精度-效率权衡；在特征维度降低、训练数据有限的资源受限条件下仍表现稳健；能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数，展现较强的表示能力。

Conclusion: SW-KAN通过在半无限域上使用Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式并配合exp-tanh映射与三项递推，同时解决了域不匹配与计算开销问题，其对数正态权重结构与可学习q参数带来独特归纳偏置，是资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [182] [Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00053)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"格式感知融合"方法，通过协同设计量化生产者、尺度域与消费者布局，在Llama-3系列8B预训练中实现FP4 Tensor Core加速，速度达37.9K tokens/s/GPU，且训练损失仅比bfloat16高2.11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP4 Tensor Core虽能加速矩阵乘法，但尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构建及反向状态保存会抵消其加速收益，因此需要跨量化生产、尺度域与消费者布局的协同设计来真正释放性能。

Method: 提出"格式感知融合"框架，将每个量化生产者与其尺度域和消费者布局协同设计，覆盖原生mxfp、全局nvfp和协作线程阵列局部nvfp三种格式。在Llama-3系列8B模型上进行1600亿token的预训练，采用bfloat16输出投影和编译交叉熵；其中mxfp结合行梯度随机舍入与固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预条件。

Result: 同加速器对比中，bfloat16与Transformer Engine nvfp分别达18.8K与27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快自定义路径达37.9K；mxfp方案达37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bfloat16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点仅高bfloat16 2.11%；TE配方加四个最终bfloat16块则以27.1K速度仅高0.87%。下游任务排名与训练损失排名并不一致。

Conclusion: FP4训练效果取决于尺度契约、操作数与执行路径的联合作用；格式感知融合可在保持训练质量的同时显著提升加速比，且下游任务排名与训练损失排名存在差异，说明评估需多维度考量。

Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global \nvfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local \nvfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine \nvfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

</details>


### [183] ["very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00083)
*Jinhao Duan,Zicheng Liu,Zijie Liu,Kaidi Xu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从认知视角研究LLM语言不确定性量化，构建人类不确定性标记语料库进行基准测试，发现LLM的数值不确定性水平与人类存在显著差异，并提出METHODNAME算法直接从LLM输出中学习最优不确定性标记画像，实现人类与LLM置信语义的标记级比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类通过"可能""很可能"等语言标记表达不确定性，但当前大多数LLM不确定性量化依赖似然或一致性信号。从认知角度看，准确的语言不确定性反映元认知监测，表征"知道自己不知道"的知识边界，支持调节与信息寻求。因此需要探究LLM与人类在语言不确定性量化上的差异，以及语言标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性。

Method: 首先从心理学和决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料库，并以此对LLM进行基准测试。随后提出METHODNAME，一种基于优化的算法，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记的最优不确定性画像；通过拟合标记-不确定性映射以最好地解释经验正确性，发现每个语言标记应传达的概率质量，而非通过重复采样估计不确定性。

Result: LLM以与人类显著不同的数值水平编码语言不确定性，存在系统性置信差异。METHODNAME支持人类与LLM之间置信语义的标记级直接比较，能够解耦不匹配并揭示语言表达中的系统性置信差异。

Conclusion: 语言标记可用于可靠量化LLM不确定性。METHODNAME实现了标记级的人机置信语义比较，揭示了系统性置信差异，为基于认知视角的LLM不确定性量化提供了新途径。

Abstract: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

</details>


### [184] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从统计角度研究基于信念的智能体记忆：在某些模型下，学习与认证有用决策所需样本量可比重建信息源可靠性少一个二次方量级，并给出可观察见证区域上的有限样本证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于信念的智能体记忆需要可靠地判断当前状态，但其证据可能含噪、被复制或已过期。核心疑问是：记忆是否必须先校准信息源，才能改进决策？论文旨在将学习、校准与修正认证三者分离，明确何时可以绕过源可靠性恢复而直接学习并证明决策改进。

Method: 论文在四模型隐马尔可夫族上分析未知贝叶斯决策的学习与认证样本复杂度，并将其与固定精度源估计进行对比；随后扩展到更广模型类、未知身份加背景报告通道，刻画策略改进的锐利可识别区间，并利用可观察见证区域构造有限样本证书，不依赖纯类锚点；进一步给出容忍有界历史依赖误设与条件复制的稳健扩展，以及适用于任意历史空间的分割训练见证与显式功效条件；最后将策略界收据与Nous Dimensions整合，在45,000条留出可变状态历史及三个外部MiniGrid记忆环境中引入噪声报告接口进行测试，并与既有推断基线比较。

Result: 在隐马尔可夫族上，学习未知贝叶斯决策需Theta(l^-2)条记录，认证其相对有信息先验incumbent的改进需O(l^-2)条来自同一观测律的新记录，而固定精度源估计在持久性l趋于零时需Theta(l^-4)，即学习与认证可比源校准少用约二次方量级样本。更广模型类保持该决策速率与源下界。在MiniGrid实验中，新证书接受9/9优于常数incumbent的改进和4/9优于last-write-wins的改进，而较早证书均未接受；强既有推断基线仍具竞争力或更优。

Conclusion: 论文给出了一个统计学解释：在特定条件下，记忆决策可以在不恢复源可靠性的前提下被学习和证明合理。它并非宣称一种普遍更优的记忆算法，而是界定可认证改进的样本复杂度与识别边界。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [185] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 掌握阈值在不同知识追踪模型下效果差异显著，需随模型与教学优先级重新校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教学系统用掌握阈值决定学生何时停止练习并进阶，但同样的数值阈值在不同知识追踪（KT）模型下会产生截然不同的决策，因此需系统检验阈值选择的影响。

Method: 在四个公开教育数据集上检验六种KT模型，评估从0.50到0.99的12个阈值，指标包括进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及不同先前表现群体间的差异；并在30种预设教学情境下识别平衡性最佳的阈值。

Result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随阈值升高变得更具选择性，部分源于输出含义不同（潜在掌握概率 vs. 下一题答对概率）。最佳平衡阈值随模型与情境差异较大，半数情境下神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10。更严格阈值并未可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能限制进阶，先前表现强的学生进阶频率可达弱者的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 掌握阈值应在KT模型或教学优先级改变时重新校准，并从表现、练习、进阶与公平获取等方面综合评估其影响。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery.
