Method: LoRA-Norm 是一种后训练归一化方法，由两部分组成：一是谱重平衡，对奇异值施加固定的非线性变换；二是核范数恢复，保持原有的总谱质量。该方法不需要校准数据，也不需要额外训练，且不引入推理开销。

Result: 在两个骨干网络和三个适配任务上，LoRA-Norm 提升了平均专精性能与能力保持，在两项指标上均优于所评估的事后谱剪枝和梯度引导编辑配置。此外，更强的函数等化并未带来一致的额外增益。

Conclusion: 平衡适配器增益与等化其响应是两个不同的目标；通过低成本的后处理重平衡增益即可有效缓解适配失衡，实现专精与能力保持的双赢。

Abstract: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned directions while rebalancing their gains. LoRA-Norm combines spectral rebalancing, a fixed nonlinear transformation of singular values, with nuclear-norm restoration, which preserves the original total spectral mass. It requires no calibration data or additional training and introduces no inference overhead. Across two backbones and three adaptation tasks, LoRA-Norm improves average specialization and capability retention, outperforming the evaluated post-hoc spectral pruning and gradient-guided editing configurations on both measures. Stronger functional equalization brings no consistent additional gains, revealing that balancing adapter gains and equalizing their responses are distinct objectives.

</details>


### [430] [Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02186)
*Yiming Huang,Yujie Zeng,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Simone Foti,Jianmin Wang,Jure Leskovec,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出高阶语法表示（HGR），将分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶语法解析为产生式规则序列，兼顾高阶拓扑表达能力与序列模型的效率；同时构建RingDiv基准和RDI指标，在生成与表示学习任务上均取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子学习模型高度依赖其底层表示，但标准序列和图形式难以显式编码环系统和重复基序等高阶拓扑。现有高阶表示虽能直接捕捉这些结构，却计算开销大、难以解码为有效分子。此外，现有基准偏向简单环系统，存在评估偏差。

Method: 提出高阶语法表示（HGR）：将分子提升为组合复形，并在上下文无关高阶语法下把每个复形解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，从而把高阶拓扑序列化，直接兼容标准序列模型，避免显式高阶编码的开销。同时构建RingDiv基准（含118万分子及RingDiv300k子集）并提出环多样性指数（RDI）量化环系统覆盖度。

Result: 在分子生成中，基于HGR的模型同时实现构造上100%有效性与领先的分布对齐，在全部五个生成基准的FCD指标上排名第一。在表示学习中，HGR-FM在两种迁移协议下于七个MoleculeNet基准取得最高平均AUC，在探测和全微调下分别比最强基线提升8.3和3.3个AUC点。

Conclusion: HGR是一种高效的高阶分子表示，兼顾拓扑表达力与计算可行性，在分子生成与可迁移表示学习上均表现优异，并配合RingDiv基准和RDI指标缓解了基准对简单环系统的偏向。

Abstract: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

</details>


### [431] [Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02098)
*Chuqin Geng,Li Zhang,Haolin Ye,Mark Zhang,Luke Zhang,Xujie Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了自动化电路发现中的"目标层面恢复差距"：基于干预定义的信度（如KL）可能偏好一个与模型行为匹配更差的等价大小电路，说明更好的发现算法本身不足以保证找到更好的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械可解释性旨在恢复模型行为背后的内部计算，而自动化电路发现常被框定为搜索问题，隐含假设"评估目标能识别出更好的电路"。作者质疑这一假设，探究干预定义的信度指标是否存在目标层面的缺陷。

Method: 在四个人类参照任务及InterpBench上，比较验证信度与固定普通重采样下留出提示的行为表现（行为标准为与完整模型一致、包含其错误；Greater-Than任务用语义准确率）。通过受控参照编辑验证无发现算法时的错排，并测试EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP的输出。分析"上下文失真"作为解释：替换被排除信号改变了保留组件的输入，并从接收方的完整模型执行中恢复选定信号来修复错排。

Result: KL在人类参照任务上对9.4%-41.2%的候选对产生错排；四种方法均表现出相同失败。恢复选定信号可在验证与留出提示上修复100个持续KL错排中的96个，而电路及其原始行为分数保持不变。

Conclusion: 当评估目标奖励错误候选时，仅改进发现算法是不够的；上下文失真是导致信度错排的原因之一。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objective-level recovery gap. Across four human-reference tasks and InterpBench, we compare validation faithfulness with behavior on held-out prompts under fixed ordinary resampling. The behavioral criterion is agreement with the intact model, including its mistakes, except on Greater-Than, where we use semantic accuracy. Controlled reference edits reveal misranking without any discovery algorithm, and outputs of EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP exhibit the same failure. Under resampling, KL misranks 9.4%-41.2% of candidate pairs across these methods on the human-reference tasks. We investigate context distortion as an explanation: replacing excluded signals changes the inputs on which retained components operate. Restoring selected signals from the recipient's intact-model execution repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings from the discovery pool on both validation and held-out prompts. The circuits and their original behavioral scores remain unchanged. These findings show why better discovery alone is insufficient when its objective rewards the wrong candidate.

</details>


### [432] [FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198)
*Sebastian Sanokowski,Alireza Sarmadi,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FERPO算法，用critic值而非动作梯度做策略改进，通过熵与KL正则化导出目标动作分布，并用前向KL加自归一化重要性采样拟合actor。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续控制在线强化学习方法通常依赖学习到的critic的动作梯度进行策略改进，但critic往往以预测回报为目标，准确的价值预测并不保证准确的动作导数，可能导致不可靠的策略更新。

Method: 提出FERPO（前向熵正则化策略优化），一种在线最大熵强化学习算法。它不通过critic对动作求导，而是仅用critic值做策略改进：由带熵和KL散度正则化的策略改进目标导出最优目标动作分布；再用从rollout策略采样的动作，通过自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）估计前向KL目标，将actor拟合到该目标分布。

Result: 在MuJoCo Playground和ManiSkill上的实验与消融显示，FERPO具有有竞争力的性能与样本效率提升；计算基准测试表明其actor更新速度快于REPPO。

Conclusion: 通过限制目标分布相对rollout策略的偏差，KL正则化使重要性权重保持良好行为；相比逆向KL目标（易偏向目标分布的少数模态），前向KL目标鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态，从而促进探索。

Abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

</details>


### [433] [Linear Programming Representations and Strongly Polynomial Algorithms for Robust Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02131)
*Han Zhong,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究具有理性多面体状态-动作矩形不确定性的鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDPs），构造了单一线性规划（LP）表示，并给出强多项式算法与复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为RMDPs寻求LP表示与强多项式算法，并改进$\ell_1$、$\ell_\infty$等RMDPs的已知复杂度界。

Method: 通过编码有限序列的鲁棒策略迭代步骤，构造一个单一LP，其最优解可恢复鲁棒最优值及所有最优平稳随机策略；并发展了一种结合不确定性集最小化代价与策略评估迭代次数的鲁棒策略迭代复杂度分析。

Result: 在固定折扣下，LP具有多项式维度和编码长度，并可在强多项式时间内构造；改进了$\ell_1$和$\ell_\infty$ RMDPs的复杂度界，并为一般区间、加权$\ell_1$、Wasserstein RMDPs以及相应的回合制随机博弈建立了新的强多项式界。

Conclusion: 该工作为多类RMDPs及回合制随机博弈提供了统一的LP表示与强多项式复杂度结果。

Abstract: We study linear programming (LP) representations and strongly polynomial algorithms for robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) with rational polyhedral state-action rectangular uncertainty in rewards and transitions. By encoding a finite sequence of robust policy-iteration steps, we construct a single LP whose optimal solutions recover the robust optimal value and all optimal stationary randomized policies. At fixed discount, the LP has polynomial dimension and encoding length and can be constructed in strongly polynomial time. We also develop a general complexity analysis of robust policy iteration that combines the cost of minimizing over uncertainty sets with the number of iterations needed to evaluate a policy. For a fixed discount factor, we use this analysis to improve the known complexity bounds for $\ell_1$ and $\ell_\infty$ RMDPs and establish new strongly polynomial bounds for general interval, weighted $\ell_1$, and Wasserstein RMDPs, as well as turn-based stochastic games with these uncertainty sets.

</details>


### [434] [Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02144)
*Ali Janati,Nikita Kuzmin,Rohit Swamy,Charles Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Faynt系列Transformer策略（10M和75M参数），用单个检查点控制《任天堂明星大乱斗》全部26个角色，通过监督预训练、课程学习、蒸馏和强化学习在同角色对战中取得98.4%胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为验证一个统一策略能否以单检查点覆盖全部26个角色，并超越针对特定角色或多角色定制的现有AI，同时探究架构、优化、扩展规律与超参数迁移对大规模人类回放预训练的作用。

Method: 基于约84万人类回放进行Transformer策略的监督预训练，研究架构、优化、扩展与超参数迁移；后训练结合排序与结果导向课程、75M到10M蒸馏，并将强化学习限制在Fox镜像对局中；评测使用自带基准套件和对战平台。

Result: 10M模型在244场同角色对战中赢240场（98.4%），对所有基线均保持胜绩；对私有无延迟Slippi-AI模型68场全胜。初始152场基准中，监督10M胜率69.7%，预训练75M为45.4%。加权验证损失与胜率排序一致。推理速度在T4上平均每决策5.2ms（10M）和8.7ms（75M）。

Conclusion: 统一单检查点策略可覆盖全部26个角色并稳定超越定制AI，加权验证损失可作为监督检查点选择的有效指标；监督后训练显著提升生存与翻盘能力，相关权重、基准和自动化赛事平台已开源。

Abstract: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M wins 69.7% of games, compared with 45.4% for the pretrained 75M, despite higher overall held-out controller-prediction loss. The weighted validation loss used for supervised checkpoint selection agrees with the win-rate ordering of all four pretrained and supervised policies. After supervised post-training, both models take less damage per minute, build larger early leads, and win more often after losing the first life. Optimized inference on recorded game states averages 5.2 ms per decision for the 10M and 8.7 ms for the 75M on an NVIDIA T4, excluding emulator execution and communication. We open-source the weights, both benchmark suites, and a platform for automated model tournaments.

</details>


### [435] [Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02158)
*Nikolaos Makras,Sotirios Sabanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对矩阵空间上非凸、非全局梯度Lipschitz的Gibbs分布采样问题，提出了一类非二次动能函数及带动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统，并证明了其收敛性与离散算法的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样方法通常要求势能为凸函数或梯度全局Lipschitz连续，但在矩阵空间等实际场景中，Gibbs分布的势能往往非凸且梯度不满足全局Lipschitz条件，导致传统方法难以适用，因此需要放宽这些假设。

Method: 引入一类非二次动能函数，构建带有动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统，其中动能梯度起到对动量的光滑谱驯化作用；随后分析该动力系统，并研究对应的Euler-Maruyama离散化。

Result: 在放宽的势能假设下，证明了该动力系统保持目标Gibbs测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下实现指数收敛到平衡态；同时证明Euler-Maruyama离散化在无需修改势能梯度的情况下具有时间一致矩界，保证了采样算法的稳定性。

Conclusion: 该工作为非凸、非全局Lipschitz势能下的Gibbs分布采样提供了理论保证，通过非二次动能与动量预条件机制实现了收敛性和离散稳定性。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.

</details>


### [436] [When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02159)
*Scott W. Viteri,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出以"反事实信息"作为探索的正式评判标准，衡量策略所获经验在替代其他策略经验时的价值；并构造了一个简单环境，证明现有的计数、预测误差、赋能和信息增益等内在奖励目标的最优策略在该标准下是帕累托次优的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内在奖励（如预测误差、学习进步）虽用于引导强化学习中的探索，但最大化这些奖励并不必然产生最具信息量的经验，缺乏对"何种经验算信息丰富"的正式刻画。

Method: 提出反事实信息评判准则：通过比较策略所获经验在多大程度上能替代其他替代策略下的经验（即历史对反事实策略的替代性）来评价策略。构造单一简单环境进行反例分析，并推导现有内在奖励成功促进最优探索的条件，同时设计一个新目标函数。

Result: 在构造的简单环境中，计数型、预测误差型、赋能型与信息增益型目标的最大化策略均在获取反事实信息方面为帕累托次优；论文解释了这些失败的原因，并给出使现有内在奖励成功鼓励最优探索的条件。

Conclusion: 反事实信息为探索提供了更合理的评判基准，揭示了常见内在奖励的局限；作者进一步构造了一个在探索依此标准严格改进时给予更高价值的目标函数。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

</details>


### [437] [Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02173)
*Areeb Ahmad,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出语言模型中的“自我修复”现象可由一个预先存在的增益机制统一解释：对因果重要组件的干预可视为某一反事实对比强度轴λ上的点，细粒度单元r的因果修复响应遵循仿射定律E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，斜率γ_r为固定系数，其符号决定该单元是抵消还是强化被移除的信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究反复观察到消融语言模型某组件后其他组件会补偿调整（自我修复），但机制不明；迄今最系统的研究认为自我修复是噪声性的、难以用单一原因解释。作者主张其有唯一解释：消融前已存在的增益。

Method: 将任何针对因果重要组件的干预视为反事实对比强度轴λ上的点（传统消融方法是该轴上未校准的点），对细粒度单元r建立仿射定律E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ；在事实判定任务上跨Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral四个模型识别遵循该定律的组件（含MLP神经元、OV神经元、奇异方向），并在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上验证。

Result: 在事实判定任务中，81个下游方向有68个遵循该仿射定律；可据固定权重预测γ_r的大小。在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路中，干预可触及的10个注意力头中有7个遵循该定律，且这7个全部是“反权重”（counterweight）。

Conclusion: 所谓自我修复，实为反权重在对比信号于核心涌现时执行其常规操作；该方法为理解模型组件交互提供了统一、可校准的定量框架。

Abstract: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

</details>


### [438] [Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02175)
*Jianru Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 蛋白质功能注释不仅要知道模型预测什么，还要知道哪些预测不可信。作者提出以组织特异性互作网络中的有效电阻（effective resistance）作为信号，发现其被度数的倒数主导（Spearman=-0.955），但残差偏离在所有24个网络中超过保度零模型，且在19个网络中能额外解释节点损失，效应随深度单调增强（增量达控制变量未解释方差的0.37%，为置换下限的5.6倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质功能注释需要判断哪些预测不可信，而不仅仅是得到预测结果。作者探究组织特异性互作结构是否携带这种"可信度"信息，即网络拓扑能否作为预测不确定性的额外信号。

Method: 选取有效电阻作为候选信号（此前用于通过重连缓解过挤压问题）。在24个组织特异性互作组上计算有效电阻，发现其被度数倒数主导。构建保度零模型图作为对照，提取残差偏离信号。控制预测熵、度数、注释基数、局部结构与纯特征难度等变量，在留出网络上检验残差对每节点损失的额外解释力，并扣除置换下限，考察随深度的变化；同时将模型在保度零世界中重训练作为额外对照。

Result: 有效电阻在24个网络中均被度数倒数主导，随共表达过滤网络增大的退化加深（Spearman=-0.955）。残差偏离在所有24个网络中超过保度零模型。控制多个变量后，残差在24个留出网络的19个中额外解释节点损失（在每个深度），效应随深度单调增强。增量达控制变量未解释方差的0.37%，为置换下限的5.6倍；而在保度零世界中重训练模型时仅为1.5倍。选择性预测几乎无改善。

Conclusion: 该信号具有可复现性，但受度数退化所限制；有效电阻残差可作为判断蛋白质功能注释预测可信度的额外拓扑信号，但度数主导性构成了其性能上限。

Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.

</details>


### [439] [From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02179)
*Siqi Zhu,Suozhi Huang,Kaixuan Zhang,Yuheng Yang,Zhanyang Jin,Yihang Sun,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)中教师信号如何影响学生参数变化，基于Qwen3-1.7B和四个RL训练的领域教师，分析梯度、优化器更新与学习曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOPD旨在将多个RL训练教师的能力整合到单个学生模型中，但教师信号如何影响参数变化尚不清楚，本文希望揭示其中的机制。

Method: 以Qwen3-1.7B为对象，使用与其同初始化的四个领域RL教师，比较梯度、优化器更新与任务学习曲线，并用SmolLM3-3B做额外诊断；分析损失平均、Adam一阶矩、BF16舍入以及top-64交叠KL梯度的影响。

Result: 损失平均隐式加权响应，token平均偏好长响应；Adam一阶矩降低参数更新差异，教师间余弦相似度0.83，平均规则间0.96；BF16舍入掩盖小变化，约97%的FP32主权重偏离初始化，仅7-11%的BF16权重偏离；top-64交叠KL梯度接近Qwen全词表梯度，但任务效果取决于平均方式，数学准确率在响应平均下比采样token策略梯度高2.6分，在全局token平均下低2.1分。

Conclusion: 教师信号受损失平均方式、优化器动量、数值精度(BF16)及梯度近似策略等多重因素影响，这些因素共同决定了MOPD中学生参数的更新与最终任务表现。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weights do. Finally, the top-64 intersection KL gradient closely matches Qwen's full-vocabulary gradient, but the effect on task performance depends on averaging: mathematics accuracy is 2.6 points higher than with sampled-token policy-gradient (PG) under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.

</details>


### [440] [Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02185)
*Weihao Liu,Huangjie Zheng,Tianrong Chen,Rohit Dilip,Richard He Bai,Yizhu Jiao,Yuyang Wang,Ruixiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LoopCD，一种无需训练的对比解码框架，利用循环 Transformer 的早期循环状态作为弱预测，与最终强预测对比来引导 token 选择，在提升解码质量的同时减少推理计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复执行共享块实现参数高效，但标准解码丢弃了早期循环的中间表示。早期循环计算更弱，天然提供了对齐的"弱-强"预测对，无需辅助模型或额外训练即可用于对比解码。

Method: LoopCD 将最终预测与较早循环的预测进行对比来指导 token 选择，有两种实现：LoopCD-Logits 在 logit 空间操作，需额外一次输出前向；LoopCD-Hidden 在隐藏状态空间操作，无额外输出开销。整个过程无需训练。

Result: 在四类循环 Transformer 上均取得一致且显著的增益：LoopCD-Logits 将 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 在 AIME 2024 的 pass@1 从 61.88% 提升至 73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden 将 Huginn 的 HumanEval pass@1 从 22.56% 提升至 31.71%。性能提升还使得循环次数减半仍可匹配或超越全深度无引导基线，前向 FLOPs 减少 22.5%–48.2%。

Conclusion: LoopCD 通过将中间循环状态转化为有效的引导信号，实现了更优的解码质量并显著降低推理计算，为循环 Transformer 的高效解码提供了新思路。

Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

</details>


### [441] [Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02189)
*Jason X. Liu,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Soojung Yang,Xinyu A. Feng,Abigail Park,Anagha Aneesh,Lacramioara Bintu,Alexander R. Dunn,Grant M. Rotskoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IDiom是一个在5400万预测IDR序列上训练的自回归蛋白语言模型,结合RL-SAE后训练方法,可生成具有指定功能特征的可解释、可组合的IDR序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在无序蛋白区域(IDRs)在转录调控、信号传导和亚细胞定位等过程中发挥关键作用,但功能设计仍具挑战性。基于结构的设计方法难以适用于IDRs,而现有蛋白语言模型在全长蛋白序列上训练,学到偏向折叠结构域的偏好。

Method: 提出IDiom——在IDiom-DB(从AlphaFold数据库筛选的5400万条预测IDR)上训练的自回归蛋白语言模型;并提出RL-SAE后训练方法,利用稀疏自编码器特征作为奖励,引导生成激活指定特征集的序列。

Result: IDiom能生成再现天然IDR组成、模式、基序和预测无序度的多样序列。在八项IDR设计任务中,RL-SAE序列平均激活30个目标特征中的90%,而激活引导仅为24%。相比引导和监督微调,RL-SAE提升了生成IDR的预测亚细胞定位和转录活性,并可将不同生物学功能相关特征组合到单一序列中。

Conclusion: IDiom与RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征,实现了可解释、可组合的IDR设计。RL-SAE有望推广到其他以可解释特征为设计目标的蛋白设计场景。代码已开源。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

</details>


### [442] [Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02190)
*Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZFO框架通过解耦方向选择与步长选择，利用一维零阶评估实现自适应曲率感知步长，提升大规模神经网络优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大步长会破坏优化稳定性，小步长则收敛缓慢，步长选择是大规模神经网络优化的核心难题。

Method: 结合零阶与一阶优化（ZFO）：用可信的一阶优化器确定方向，仅沿该一维子空间进行零阶评估，利用当前梯度信息和两次额外目标函数评估构造局部模型，在有界区间内选择曲率感知步长。

Result: 理论上证明共享样本评估能产生可靠的有限差分曲率估计、局部模型能选出近最优步长、ZFO能收敛到稳定点邻域；实验表明在语言模型和数据集上常优于固定步长一阶基线，效果依赖目标函数。

Conclusion: ZFO以低于完整线搜索的成本实现自适应步长选择，能有效改善优化与最终性能，且代码已公开。

Abstract: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how far to move. Using the current {gradient information} and two additional objective function evaluations, ZFO instances construct a local model of the objective function along the proposed direction and select a curvature-aware step within a bounded search interval. This yields an adaptive step-selection mechanism that costs less than a full line search. We provide theoretical guarantees to show that shared-sample evaluations produce reliable finite-difference curvature estimates, that the induced local model selects a near-optimal step along the search interval, and that ZFO converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point. Across the evaluated settings, language models and datasets, ZFO frequently improves optimization and final performance relative to fixed-step first-order baselines, with the magnitude and preferred local model depending on the objective. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework.

</details>


### [443] [The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02191)
*Shuo Xing,Zilin Dai,Chengyuan Qian,Fangzhou Lin,Wenjing Chen,Ping He,Pan Lu,Alvaro Velasquez,Mohit Bansal,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"数学基元"概念与Prism基准，从四维度系统诊断LLM的数学理解，发现解题准确率掩盖能力差异、Discovery是主瓶颈，并提出PrismDistill自蒸馏框架提升数学推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽在前沿数学问题上表现突出，但缺乏证据表明其真正具备支撑解题的结构性数学理解。现有评估通常只看最终答案准确率，无法揭示模型的理解层次与具体能力短板，因此需要系统性地研究并诊断LLM的数学理解。

Method: 1) 提出"数学基元(Mathmetical Primitive)"概念用于探测结构性数学理解；2) 构建Prism基准，从Discovery(发现)、Generation(生成)、Digestion(消化)、Execution(执行)四个维度评估数学推理；3) 基于该基准做系统诊断与后训练分析；4) 提出PrismDistill——一种基元优先的自蒸馏框架，选择性将基元引导的推理迁移到学生模型。

Result: 诊断显示：解题准确率掩盖了模型间不同的能力画像；基元能够释放大量潜在执行能力；Discovery是数学推理的主导瓶颈；受限于Discovery的失败尤其容易被修复。实验表明PrismDistill在多种模型规模和挑战性基准上均持续优于基线。

Conclusion: 通过引入数学基元与Prism基准，可从结构性理解层面而非仅答案准确率来诊断LLM数学能力；据此设计的PrismDistill自蒸馏框架能有效提升数学推理表现，为理解与改进LLM数学能力提供了新路径。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce \abs{}, a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \abs{} consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.

</details>


### [444] [Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02195)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究图上的广义Schrödinger桥问题，指出状态代价可通过Feynman-Kac倾斜融入参考过程，从而无需时序差分惩罚，桥可通过两次端点重缩放精确计算。实验表明方法在蛋白质折叠和路网任务上有效且具线性内存扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义Schrödinger桥在图上的求解通常依赖学习受控连续时间马尔可夫链的速率，并引入时序差分惩罚来恢复代价，这带来学习复杂度和近似误差。论文旨在找到一种无需学习、无需时间离散化的精确求解途径。

Method: 将状态代价作为Feynman-Kac倾斜折叠进参考过程，把代价增强的桥转化为针对倾斜参考过程的普通桥，从而消除惩罚项。通过交替进行两次端点重缩放（每次为稀疏矩阵指数运算）精确计算桥；对时间平均占据量的二次拥堵代价，采用围绕精确桥的阻尼最佳响应，等价于强凸函数上的梯度下降。

Result: 交替迭代的收敛速率仅由端点耦合决定。在蛋白质折叠模型上，自由能代价降低了折叠路径的期望势垒；在学习方法所用的路网上，精确桥的roll-out在采样误差内匹配目标分布；在拥有数百万交叉点的网络上，内存随规模线性增长。

Conclusion: 状态代价可通过Feynman-Kac倾斜被吸收进参考过程，使代价增强桥退化为普通桥而无需时序差分惩罚；由此得到的精确桥计算仅需端点重缩放，避免了时间离散化与学习，并在大规模网络上具备可扩展性。

Abstract: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. On a protein-folding model, a free-energy cost lowers the expected barrier of the folding paths. On the learned approach's road network, roll-outs of the exact bridge match the target within sampling error, and on networks with millions of intersections its memory grows linearly.

</details>


### [445] [TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02199)
*Jichao Jiang,Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Hanqin Cai,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TACO优化器，通过每列选取最大幅值元素符号来实现精确最陡下降方向，大幅降低LLM全参数微调的优化器状态内存，同时保持精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型全参数微调时，优化器状态内存开销巨大，限制了在现有GPU上可训练的模型规模。现有方法或压缩优化器状态、或放弃一阶梯度、或在保留稠密状态的同时改变更新几何。Muon虽降低了内存，但其几何与AdamW不同，微调AdamW预训练模型时会导致性能下降。因此需要一种既降低优化器内存，又不牺牲精度和计算效率的方法。

Method: 提出Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse优化器（TACO）。它沿用Muon的算子范数最陡下降视角，但将几何路径进一步推进：在维度归一化的$1\to1$算子范数下，通过选取二维权重矩阵每一列中最大幅值元素的符号，计算精确的最陡下降方向。该方法保留一阶梯度，同时使优化器状态内存几乎可忽略。实际实现中，TACO每列仅维护一小组低精度梯度分量。

Result: 在OPT-13B上，相对于AdamW8bit，TACO将持久优化器状态减少$174\times$（从27.7 GB降至0.16 GB），峰值训练内存降低$2.9\times$（从80.6 GB降至27.5 GB），同时达到相当的精度和运行时间。TACO还使得在单张80 GB H100 GPU上对30-32B参数模型进行全参数微调成为可能，覆盖多种模型家族和任务。

Conclusion: TACO在显著降低优化器状态内存和峰值训练内存的同时，保持了与AdamW8bit相当的精度和运行效率，并支持在单张80 GB H100上对30-32B参数模型进行全参数微调。

Abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial optimizer state memory overhead, limiting the model sizes that fit on modern GPUs. Existing approaches either compress optimizer state, abandon first-order gradients, or change the update geometry while retaining dense state. The recently introduced Muon optimizer reduces optimizer memory through matrix-valued updates. Still, its geometry differs from AdamW and can lead to performance degradation when fine-tuning AdamW-pretrained models. To reduce optimizer memory without sacrificing accuracy or computational efficiency in LLM fine-tuning, we propose Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse optimizer, or TACO, which follows Muon's operator-norm steepest-descent view but takes the geometric route further. TACO computes the exact steepest-descent direction under a dimension-normalized $1\to1$ operator norm by selecting the sign of the largest magnitude entry in each column of two-dimensional weight matrices. This retains first-order gradients while making optimizer state memory nearly negligible. Our practical TACO optimizer maintains only a small set of low precision gradient components per column, reducing persistent optimizer state by $174\times$ relative to AdamW8bit (from 27.7 GB to 0.16 GB) and peak training memory by $2.9\times$ (from 80.6 GB to 27.5 GB) on OPT-13B, while achieving comparable accuracy and runtime. TACO further enables full-parameter fine-tuning of 30-32B-parameter models on a single 80 GB H100 GPU across multiple model families and tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [446] [Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00447)
*Anson Y. Lam,Shuqing Li,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文审计了文本到3D渲染图像评估排行榜的稳定性，发现评价结果高度依赖相机与提示词等协议配置，排行榜获胜者会随配置变化，但多数反转为描述性而非统计确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到3D生成任务的排行榜通常基于渲染图像评估，而相机设置和提示词措辞本身构成测量协议的一部分。作者希望检验：当生成场景固定不变时，仅改变评估协议是否就能改变排行榜结果，从而揭示评估结论的稳健性问题。

Method: 使用来自六个生成器的300个冻结场景，变化八种渲染与提示词因素，涉及19个对齐评估器和1个感知质量对照，并测试四种有针对性的场景退化。通过方差分解、提示词自助法下界、排序稳定性、成对协议边际包络以及同时推断来分离分数稳定性、决策不确定性与针对性敏感性。

Result: 对17/19个对齐评估器，峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，11/19的提示词自助法下界大于1。排序比分数更稳定，但18/19的评估器在某种配置下会改变点估计获胜者。成对协议边际包络显示部分比较能保持方向；部分选定对出现相反的点态区间，但在全搜索同时推断下没有反转成立。敏感性方面，即使无提示词对照，在布局打乱上的平局调整方向判别率也不超过67%。

Conclusion: 观察到的获胜者变化是描述性的，而非对生成器优越性的确认性变化。评估应报告（生成器、分数、卡片ID），采用依赖协议的比较和考虑选择的不确定性；同时需将分数稳定性、决策不确定性与针对性敏感性分开报告。

Abstract: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

</details>


### [447] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出以"记忆使用形态"（核心—长尾结构）作为评估外部记忆的新视角，并据此设计基于秩的记忆控制器CTWM，在保持覆盖与精度的同时降低提示词元开销与长尾预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程语言智能体日益依赖外部记忆作为"冻结的世界模型"，但现有记忆系统多以任务成功率或词元成本为评价标准，忽略了记忆使用分布的形态问题。在有限上下文与反复检索下，记忆可能高度集中于一个小核心，而稀有状态滞留在长尾中，导致预测误差不断累积。作者认为这一"核心—长尾"形态本身是缺失的评估对象，也具备作为控制信号的潜力。

Method: 首先进行保守的"长尾审计"，观察不同策略下记忆检索痕迹的分布形态：随机游走智能体产生与对数正态相容的检索痕迹，语义LLM策略则产生最强的截断幂律相容的核心—长尾痕迹。基于该审计结果，提出核心—长尾世界模型（CTWM）——一个基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数τ分配提示预算，同时保留经过摘要的长尾部分，以兼顾头部核心与尾部稀有状态。

Result: 在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM在保持完整状态与转移覆盖的同时，相比图记忆基线减少5.9%提示词元，并将下半部长尾预测误差降低13.6%。在ALFWorld上配对比较获得一致的词元节省；在LongMemEval上实现24.48%的词元缩减，且总体准确率持平。审计还表明记忆集中现象可复现，但依赖策略。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索条件下的诊断性现象，还可作为实用的控制信号，用于构建更词元高效、长尾更稳健的智能体世界模型。核心—长尾视角为记忆系统的评估与设计提供了新的维度。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [448] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出FedCausalCompose，一个面向模块化LLM智能体的因果世界模型框架，用局部动作作为跨模块接口的干预-响应证据，并指出因果结构只有在跨模块接口可统计识别且以智能体可用的形式呈现时才有帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体通过模块化系统（订单、支付、库存、物流等）行动，一个模块的动作会改变另一模块的合法转换。标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但观测轨迹并非干预时规划所需的量：它可能显示支付先于发货，却无法区分支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介该效应，还是存在隐藏触发因素同时解释两者。

Method: 提出FedCausalCompose因果世界模型框架，利用局部动作提供跨模块接口的干预-响应证据；在理论上分析无阻塞后门路径下观测世界模型的不可约干预误差、接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度的提升，以及覆盖率与局部机制误差受控时oracle因果组合可超越非因果下界；随后在诊断性智能体环境中检验该预测。

Result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境中帮助最大，因为API签名暴露了前置条件和下游效应；相反，对话与叙事环境往往忽略原始边列表，除非加入简短的注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。

Conclusion: 因果世界模型在LLM智能体中发挥作用的具体条件是：跨模块接口既在统计上可识别，又以智能体在动作时可用的形式呈现。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [449] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Praxa 是一个显式区分"提议—授权—派发—验证外部效果—上线推广"状态的语言模型智能体框架，论文以四条证据线报告其本地审计、Terminal-Bench 试点、协调代理开发对比与部署配置证据，结论是当前证据仅支持"可测试的证据绑定架构"，不支持安全性、优越性或用户收益等主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为现有大模型智能体往往把"提出动作"与"获得授权、实际派发、产生经核实的外部效果、进入服务推广"混为一谈，而这些其实是不同层级的声明。需要一个能将这些状态显式化、可验证的架构基础。

Method: 提出 Praxa 智能体执行框架，通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部读回、对账与人工评审推广来显式表示状态。评估采用四条证据线：一是在固定修订版本上的仓库本地审计（单元测试、Workerd 测试、源文件插桩与覆盖率门槛）；二是基于供应商的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点（12 个精选任务，对比基线与可靠性层）；三是调试后的双序协调代理开发对比（基线与候选方案各 180 次试验）；四是已部署源码与配置证据（有界反思、召回记账、内存编译、工具健康路径）。

Result: 审计线通过 1,027/1,027 单元测试与 89/89 Workerd 测试，插桩全部 363 个预期源文件并满足四项覆盖率门槛，但原始逐测试记录与独立复现缺失；Terminal-Bench 试点中基线与可靠性层各通过 17/36 严格试验，可靠性层多用 37.49% 输入与 50.73% 输出 token，不支持其更优；协调代理对比中两方案均完成 180/180 试验、准确率相同、具备完整崩溃恢复且零受保护违规，候选方案少用 37.11% token、估算端点成本低 33.84%、步数少 11.63%；部署证据显示若干机制路径存在，但无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa 受支持的贡献是一个证据绑定架构，使"授权到效果"的转换显式且可测试。现有证据尚不足以确立对抗性安全、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [450] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"消息干预"诊断方法，固定证据与候选答案、仅改变reasoner传给verifier的rationale，发现忠实rationale对答案准确率几乎无增益，而损坏rationale会大幅改变支持判断，提示rationale传递应作为验证消息机制而非仅追求答案准确率来评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色分工的QA流水线越来越多地将rationale从reasoner传给verifier，但这种消息传递究竟带来的是更好的答案、更强的支持评估，还是新的失败面，目前并不清楚。作者希望厘清该通道的真实作用与风险。

Method: 提出消息干预诊断：固定证据和候选答案，只改变跨越reasoner-to-verifier边界的rationale。在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA的400个样本上，用DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器；对比无rationale、忠实rationale、损坏rationale、无害改写等条件，并设置盲验证器提示与显式rationale检查提示；辅以人工审计及跨模型、任务边界检验。

Result: 忠实rationale相对无rationale几乎不提升答案准确率；损坏rationale强烈改变支持判断。盲提示下无害改写仅使支持判断变动0–2.5%，损坏rationale变动10–22%；显式rationale检查提示将同样模式放大到34–55%。最终答案变动较小（2–30%），仅2.9–35.3%的支持翻转伴随答案变化。人工审计中42个有效损坏里16个为"损坏过度信任"案例，盲测人类拒答或标记不清10个人工审计的损坏rationale中有9个被模型接受。

Conclusion: rationale共享应被作为验证消息机制来评估，而不仅仅是通往更高答案准确率的途径；跨模型与任务边界检查表明该通道可能活跃、被放大、惰性或被并入任务标签。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [451] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文构建了4个SLM微任务基准，设置CI感知的合格阈值，发现Qwen3 0.6-8B在16种配置下全部不合格，失败原因可借助logprob决策阈值诊断区分为能力不足与阈值可调两类；4-bit量化会带来损害但不改变合格结论，该差距更多与模型规模相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent系统希望用小型语言模型（SLM）处理前沿LLM规划器周边的微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次）。作者想检验现成SLM能否达到从业者定义的阈值，若不能则探究原因，以及量化是否会改变结论。

Method: 构建包含4个微任务的基准，使用固定提示和自动指标，每个任务预设阈值τ（锚定于廉价非LLM基线）并采用CI感知的合格规则（配置需其置信界超过τ才算通过）。在Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B上以最优设置（FP16、贪心、单一冻结提示、不调参）进行扫描；用logprob决策阈值诊断区分失败类型；对4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）进行评估；并在Llama-3.x上复现，还对锚点选择与提示措辞做稳健性检验。

Result: 出现合格性差距：16种配置（4任务×4模型）无一合格，经原始输出与解析器行为核验。logprob诊断将失败分为能力缺陷与可通过改变解码阈值解决的失败（4种情形）。4-bit量化损害依模型规模而异，但没有任何配置因此变为合格；差距更多随模型规模而非精度变化。在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择（τ扫描）和提示措辞（原始加3个中性改写每题共0/112合格）均稳健。

Conclusion: 实际建议是将SLM置于满足CI支持阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达标处使用SLM；例如用4B重排器对BM25候选集重排可超过BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但其自身并未达到合格标准。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [452] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文隔离并系统检验了"PRM剪枝片段嫁接"（PPFG）这一推理时干预机制，发现在既定工作点上其效果与独立并行思维链基线无统计学差异，并通过等价性检验将其提升为"正等价"结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行思维链存在多样性坍缩（diversity collapse），促使研究者提出各类推理时干预。其中一种自然设计是：当过程奖励模型（PRM）剪枝某条链时，提取其高PRM前缀并原样嫁接为上下文示范，注入到仍在解码的兄弟链中。既有片段嫁接工作声称的收益仅在附加补偿性成分时出现。本文旨在隔离该机制（PPFG），作为跨轨迹步级迁移的最低成本实现，并在最具挑战的操作点上检验其是否真正有效。

Method: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd 上对完整 MATH500（n=500，三个随机种子）测试。设计停滞靶向与随机靶向两种 PPFG 变体。通过四桶分类对 322 个停滞规则注入事件进行归因分析；尝试多种复合门控精炼；引入随机对照；跨三个基础模型、六个基准、第二个 PRM 及兼容性门控扫描进行复现；采用双单侧检验（TOST）进行等价性分析；进行逐事件抽查与存活兄弟反事实分析；并用事后预言机估计上界。

Result: PPFG 两种变体在所有测量轴上均与独立并行思维链基线统计不可区分。四桶分类显示仅 14% 的注入事件真正命中"挣扎中"的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或处于 PRM 平台期的链上——救援嫁接无法改变这些状态。无复合门控能同时满足"良好靶向"与"足够密度"，随机对照以 2.4 倍触发率得到同样的平价结果，说明惰性并非启发式特有。结论在三个基础模型、六个基准、第二 PRM 和兼容性门控扫描中复现；TOST 将十二个 Qwen/LLaMA 单元格的平价提升为正等价。逐事件抽查发现注入链的剪枝率为匹配步的 2.75 倍，但存活兄弟反事实未发现群体层面的补偿。事后预言机将"选择 PPFG 而非独立"的每题增益上界限定为 +0.13 个百分点。

Conclusion: PPFG 在测试的操作点上不产生可测量的收益，其惰性根源于靶向机制的结构性缺陷而非特定启发式。本文贡献了一个用于建立推理时机制零结果的等价性检验模板，所有结论均限定于其被检验的操作点范围内。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [453] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GAP-DPO，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，通过效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择与逐轮重生成来控制分布偏移，实验证明其在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量上优于标准 DPO 变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化大语言模型需要让生成行为对齐用户特定偏好，而非仅追求总体质量。DPO 虽为偏好学习提供了稳定框架，但在个性化场景下其效果关键取决于偏好对的选择方式。现有方法多依赖启发式标准（如基于似然的极端样本），使优化与显式用户效用解耦，可能导致个性化效果下降。因此作者希望从优化几何角度重新理解偏好对选择，并建立其与用户效用之间的理论联系。

Method: 作者将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐的优化问题，通过分析期望用户效用梯度与 DPO 更新方向之间的一阶交互来展开研究。分析表明，在离策略采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO 更新会从纯误差纠正信号转变为类强化学习更新。基于这一洞见，提出 GAP-DPO：一种迭代算法，执行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮重生成（epoch-wise regeneration）控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO 相较标准 DPO 变体持续提升了风格保真度、偏好对齐度和生成质量。

Conclusion: 研究确立了梯度对齐作为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，并表明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式的预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [454] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源的本地 AI 科研助手，通过科学脚手架、不可删除的 Living Lab Notebook 和可信观测日志三大设计，针对模型过度声称这一常见失效模式，在跨学科科研任务中超越了商业平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用聊天助手和编程智能体缺乏科研场景所需的科学流程支持、可追溯的论证记录与可信的过程审计，且模型过度声称（overclaiming）是最常见的失效模式。作者希望构建一个运行在研究者自有机器上、数据与记录长期可读的科研辅助工具，使科研声明可被核查而非单纯依赖模型自述。

Method: K-Dense BYOK 采用 BYOK 模式，由研究者提供模型（云端或本地），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录；每个项目为普通文件夹，数据、代码、结果与记录均存于研究者自管机器。核心包含三项设计：一是内置科学程序库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据目录及审稿与写作角色；二是 Living Lab Notebook，条目相互链接形成论证且只增不删；三是以观测智能体行为而非采信其自述的方式记录过程，日志智能体无写入工具。评估采用二十个跨学科研究提示，按事先固定的评分标准打分，并与两个托管平台对比。

Result: 在二十个跨学科研究提示下，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行两方面均领先两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的，也是唯一通常附带可复现结果命令的。其中一个托管平台使用了相同的前沿模型，却未提供这两项。此外，环境记录是智能体写入的文件，而非观测日志的一部分，观测日志目前尚未捕获软件环境本身。

Conclusion: K-Dense BYOK 通过科学脚手架、不可删除的活页实验记录与不可篡改的观测日志，将重点放在让科研声明可被核查，从而应对模型过度声称问题，并在跨学科任务中展现出优于托管平台的科学质量与执行能力。代码以 MIT 许可证开源。当前局限在于观测日志尚未覆盖软件环境本身，环境记录仍依赖智能体自写文件。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [455] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在9个科学基准（4,531题、100个职业画像）与60道生物信息学工具题上，详细的职业专属系统提示并未带来稳定准确率提升，却使输出token增至1.5–2.3倍、单次成功调用成本增至2.2–4.5倍，甚至使工具题解题率下降10.0个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍为智能体加载详尽的职业专属系统提示，但这一做法推高token消耗与响应成本，却缺乏证据表明其能带来一致的准确率增益。作者希望实证检验"详细职业画像是否值得默认加载"这一实际部署问题。

Method: 作者构建并评估Scientific Agents——一个包含503个职业专属AGENTS.md画像的开源语料库，采用Gemini 3.8 Flash、经OpenRouter在Pi智能体框架中运行。实验对比匹配画像与四种对照：极简基线（"You are a helpful assistant"）、画像开篇角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、以及来自无关领域的画像。评测覆盖九个文本类科学基准（采样4,531题、100个匹配画像），经API错误重试后4,488条完成全部五种条件，采用自动化规则评分；另在60道需调用工具的BioMysteryBench生物信息学题上各运行三次。

Result: 画像与基线的平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（固定任务上的95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无任何基准显示统计上明确的改善。匹配画像产生1.5–2.3倍的输出token，每次成功调用成本高2.2–4.5倍。在60道工具题上，画像平均解题率46.7%，基线56.7%，相差-10.0个百分点（95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），原因是画像下更频繁触及token与时间上限而中止。另有一个意外发现：SuperGPQA上频繁的供应商API中断使短基线仅54.0%的题目保有正确的首轮答案，而画像为71.6%；通用与不匹配提示的可靠性与之相近，说明该优势来自提示长度或格式而非领域专业性。

Conclusion: 在测试所用模型与任务上，默认加载完整职业画像不会提升准确率，且成本显著更高，因此不宜作为默认策略。作者建议未来检验选择性检索画像片段或面向开放式科学任务是否可能改变这一结论。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [456] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究对话幽默训练中的自动化奖励及其被"钻空子"的问题与对策，发现惊讶度奖励和观众笑声预测奖励均存在可被利用的捷径，最终评估有提升但仍未达预期目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话幽默任务中人工标注成本高，研究者希望用自动化奖励来训练语言模型，但自动化奖励容易被模型利用（reward exploit）。因此需要系统检视这些奖励的脆弱性并设计对策。

Method: 采用两类奖励：基于嵌入的"可理解惊讶度"奖励和预测观众发笑的"观众模型"奖励。通过受控实验检测漏洞（如词序打乱回复、说话人笑声线索），并分别加入流畅度过滤器与跨说话人归一化作为对策，再进行三轮强化学习训练迭代修正奖励。

Result: 惊讶度奖励会把词序打乱的回复当成机智回复；流畅度过滤能识别打乱，但会误伤部分机智回复且后续验证不通过。观众模型易被说话人消息中的笑声线索操纵，跨说话人归一化可阻挡已覆盖的攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可利用。最终一轮训练使综合评分提高0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升仍低于预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计的核心难题在于：对策既要封堵可被利用的捷径，又要保留奖励原本意图鼓励的行为，二者难以兼顾。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [457] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EviGraph区分"关键决策要求"与"可保留未决信息"，用语言智能体将要求关联到时序知识图谱中的证据，并由确定性检查器判定推荐是否有支撑，从而减少不必要的弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务内容、范围和日期相匹配的证据；但若把每个缺失细节都当作决定因素，会导致过度弃答，损失有用推荐。因此需要区分哪些是决策必须建立的关键要求。

Method: 提出EviGraph：语言智能体将关键决策要求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，确定性检查器判定推荐是否被证据支撑。并在双语香港公共服务基准（含可执行政策引用）上进行评测。

Result: 该方法减少了不必要的弃答。但额外验证会撤回本已受支撑的推荐，且并未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的循证式导航取决于明确"决策必须建立什么"，而非单纯增加验证步骤。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [458] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Build2SPARQL，一个面向楼宇知识图谱的大规模text-to-SPARQL基准，通过图遍历代码生成并验证SPARQL、由大模型仅生成自然语言问题，覆盖201个楼宇KG，产出6,136条可执行查询和30,680个问题，并给出检索增强评估结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 楼宇自动化系统日益以Brick、ASHRAE 223P等本体构建成语义知识图谱，为AI应用提供机器可读基础。将自然语言问题翻译为SPARQL可让运维人员用语言代理查询图谱，但该方向受限于缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准，因此需要构建此类基准。

Method: 采用KG-grounded流水线：SPARQL查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，大模型仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而使查询正确性独立于模型行为。流水线挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并将每个查询表述为五种词汇寄存器。应用于201个楼宇KG（180个Brick、21个ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 共生成6,136条可执行SPARQL查询和30,680个问题。对300个问题进行双标注者人工验证，语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、操作合理性84.0%。在三个开放权重语言模型上进行检索增强评估，精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索的56-65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL提供了大规模、高质量且查询正确性可控的楼宇知识图谱text-to-SPARQL基准，并通过检索增强显著提升模型表现，为楼宇运维的自然语言查询应用奠定基础。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [459] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在受约束信号博弈中引入知情对手，证明对抗稳健的最优信号恰与既有工作的"显著性极点"重合，二者仅在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义的条目上有别。这一结构性巧合导致无法实证检验语言模型是否具备对手意识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当知情对手与听者共享同一受限信号通道时，最优信号应如何选择？作者希望厘清对抗稳健信号与既有启发式（显著性）信号之间的关系，并考察该关系对实证评测（如语言模型的对手意识）的影响。

Method: 将对手引入一个迫选任务（抽象自桌游《血契与谎言》中的谋杀推理）：对手知道目标、观察信号，并以说服预算 β 为最强错误答案辩护。推导随 β 变化的最优信号；在 108 个确认性条目和 200,000 条目池上对比对抗稳健最优与显著性极点；并对七个语言模型施加两种对手框架进行评测。

Result: 在 108 个确认性条目上，对抗稳健最优与显著性极点完全一致；在 200,000 条目池中仅 2,748 条不同，且恰好是显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义之处。β 增大时最优信号从后验最大化选项转向边际最大化选项，β=0 时复原原 oracle 模型（τ=1）。18.2% 的条目池在有限预算下最优解发生移动，且临界预算精确可算。两种对手框架在 108 题中的 30 至 77 题上改变了七个语言模型的选择。

Conclusion: 对抗稳健目标与启发式（显著性）目标在评测条目上常常重合，因此无法判断模型选择的变化是趋向对手意识最优还是趋向显著性——这是结构性局限，而非零结果。建议在评测对手意识前先做廉价诊断：检验稳健目标是否与启发式目标重合。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [460] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究数据顺序（顺序排列）对模型参数的影响，证明学习率调度是决定顺序效应的核心算子：其以"块周期×端点权重"的乘积形式进入顺序效应界。常数调度下内部差异显著且随块状程度单调，而余弦衰减调度下几乎消失。实验显示顺序切换效应达12.29σ，但在约定无关指标下恰为零，标记约定可坍缩该切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者关注同一语料以两种互不相容但都正确的约定书写时，数据顺序会在参数中写入什么。核心动机是将学习率调度从"背景条件"提升为决定顺序效应是否出现的核心机制，并揭示现有精确匹配基准无法察觉这一效应。

Method: 对同一语料构造十种顺序，固定预算与其余一切、仅改变路径，在两个仅lr_scheduler_type不同的调度族下各运行两次：一族为常数学习率，另一族为单一余弦衰减。通过推导的界将排列（仅以块周期形式）与调度（仅以端点权重形式）作为相乘因子分离分析，并在十二组臂上比较acc_A+acc_B守恒性与分配份额。

Result: 常数率下内部差异跨越0.2221分配与11.63对比下限，并随块状程度单调变化；余弦调度下同样的十组臂仅落入两个可区分状态（自身分辨率本可容纳约十种）。十二组臂中acc_A+acc_B在9.7%内保持恒定，而分配份额在0.04至0.87间变化，测得12.29σ的顺序切换在约定无关指标下恰为零。标记约定后切换坍缩，达到并集上界的87.5%。

Conclusion: "顺序重要"与"顺序不重要"是同一旋钮的两端，学习率调度决定其位置：衰减调度因无法在同一时刻同时放置大步长与未收缩余项而抑制顺序效应，常数调度在最后一步恰好同时具备两者。路径写入的是模型承诺的约定，任何精确匹配基准都无法观测，而约定守恒在衰减族中读数更稳定；在提示中标记约定可坍缩该切换并逼近并集上界。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>


### [461] [Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00282)
*Yezhou Cheng,Runjia Du,Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"grounded correction arbitration"（对纠正行为进行仲裁）任务，让具身智能体在"接受、拒绝、检查世界、询问说话者"之间选择，并实现GAVA框架（基于观察受限证据、合法探查与单步期望损失规则）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当人的纠正可能错误时，具身智能体需要决定是否采信、拒绝、自行观察还是向对方询问。现有研究缺乏对这一仲裁选择的形式化以及可比较的成本评估。

Method: 在纯文本ALFWorld中，162个检查点生成972对真假纠正干预；GAVA采用观察受限证据、合法探查和一步期望损失规则，并与"总是验证"等基线在交互成本、声明联合成本等指标上比较。加入训练专用物体位置先验，并在冻结策略、成本、基线与多重性方案后进行重复验证。

Result: 完整局部检查下GAVA与"总是验证"均达100%纠正准确率（证据契约而非比较优势）；同回合执行中GAVA相对"总是验证"降低交互成本，但在完美说话者下与成本阈值持平。加入先验在340个未见场景上使交互与声明联合成本分别相对均匀GAVA降低0.490与0.420；在77个不重叠已见检查点（308场景）上复制为0.595与0.517，95%检查点自助置信区间均不含零。联合成本也优于相同先验的固定策略，但匹配校准的无VOI比较结论不确定。语义GAVA每队列4个事实错误，准确率98.8%与98.7%，所有方法均完成全部任务。

Conclusion: 结果支持在明确成本下结合语义先验进行选择性信息收集，但未能确立环境信息价值相对澄清询问的普遍优势；研究限于规范化声明、完整符号观察和受控说话者，未评估真人、视觉输入或物理机器人。

Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

</details>


### [462] [Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00313)
*Jingjie Ning,Guojiang Zhao,Chen Xu,Shanshan Zhong,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Guolin Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R2T 将公开科学需求转化为可执行检查，匹配对比发现其修复成功率略优于纯文本，但效果依赖任务，并伴随公有 CPU 开销上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码智能体需依据书面方程、边界条件与输出要求来评估并修订程序，书面规范存在歧义或难以验证，因此需要考察“预先准备好的可执行检查”能否提升修复效果与降低成本。

Method: 提出 Rules to Tools (R2T)：把公开科学需求转化为可调用、可执行的检查。设置匹配的 SciCode 修复组，共享书面检查、起始程序、模型与预算，工具组额外获得可调用实现；比较两个 task-ID 队列、共享定义队列、开发暴露任务，并加入 fresh source-through-Python 臂与匹配 PDE 对比。

Result: 两个 task-ID 队列：文本 26/30，工具 29/30（3 个任务利于工具、1 个利于文本、11 个平局）。八 ID 队列 13/16 对 15/16，任务簇 bootstrap 95% 区间 [-12.5, 43.75] 个百分点。共享定义队列平局 13/24。五个开发暴露任务 3/10 对 7/10。任务 17、77、11 利于工具，其中 17 被初始检查标记，77、11 无违规报告；任务 37 利于文本且无初始违规。fresh 臂达 15/16，与专用命令持平。匹配 PDE 对比中文本 23/24、检查 24/24，检查组报告模型输出低 31.2%；智能体侧输出节省随队列变化，公有 CPU 使用在两个队列均上升。

Conclusion: 可执行检查能在多数任务上带来小幅但任务依赖的修复增益，并降低智能体侧模型输出，但会增加公有 CPU 开销；其收益不能一概而论，需结合具体任务与成本权衡。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements.
